# AGENTS.md — isar-labs · Atira EHL Challenge „From RFQ to bid"

Dieses Dokument ist die verbindliche Arbeitsanweisung für alle Coding-Agents (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) und Menschen
im Team. Lies es vollständig, bevor du Code schreibst. Details stehen in `docs/` (Index unten); bei Widerspruch gilt
die Reihenfolge: **Challenge-Brief der Plattform > dieses Dokument > docs/**.

## 1. Mission in einem Absatz

Wir bauen ein Agentensystem, das in einer Sandbox (20 min, bis zu 4 Chromium-Browser über CDP, nur Plattform +
4 Websites erreichbar) ein öffentliches Tender beantwortet: Vergabeportal (Ausschreibung, Bieterfragen, Konfigurator),
Lieferantenportal (Lastenheft/Spezifikation), ERP (Material, Bestand, Konditionen) und Webmail (Freigaben, TAN).
Am Ende wird **ein** signiertes Angebot im Konfigurator des Vergabeportals abgegeben. Gewertet wird:
**eligible (richtige Tender-Referenz) → Qualität 0–100 → Kosten × Zeit**. Gewinner: zuerst **privater Datensatz**
(andere Websites, anderes Layout, andere Navigation, Informationen anders verteilt!), dann public, dann Eleganz.

➡️ Wir optimieren für **Generalität und Korrektheit**, nicht für das öffentliche Szenario.

## 2. Nicht verhandelbare Regeln (Fair Play — Verstoß = Disqualifikation)

1. **Keine hardcodierten Szenario-Werte** in `agent/` — weder Code, Config, Prompts, Kommentare, Defaults, Fallbacks
   noch Tests: keine Tender-Referenzen, Materialnummern, Preise, Rabatte, Keys (`VP-…`, `TZ-…`, `K-…`, `RP-…`, `PB-…`,
   `MET-…`, `FX-…`, `ER-…`, `GR-…`), Logins, TANs, URLs-Pfade der Public-Sites. Werte aus dem **Brief** (den jeder Lauf
   bekommt) dürfen zur Laufzeit gelesen werden. Die **Regeln** (Rechenlogik) dürfen wir implementieren.
2. **Ein LLM entscheidet die Navigation**: wohin klicken, was suchen, welches Dokument relevant ist. Code darf helfen
   (Seite extrahieren, ausgewähltes Dokument parsen, vom Modell gewählte Ergebnisliste paginieren, rechnen, validieren,
   retry, Formular füllen). **Verboten**: fester Klickpfad, Crawler der alles einsammelt und am Ende einem Modell gibt.
3. Keine eigenen Browser in der Sandbox starten (nur `CDP_URLS`), keine lokalen Modelle, kein Netzwerk außer
   Plattform/Websites/Proxy, alle LLM-Calls über den Proxy (`*_BASE_URL`-Variablen).
4. Keine Secrets im Repo. Eigene API-Keys nur als Team-Secret auf der Plattform.
5. Nichts im Package, was den AI-Reviewer „steuern“ soll (Kommentare an den Reviewer zählen gegen uns).
6. `submit`/`cancel` auf der Plattform **nur nach ausdrücklicher Freigabe eines Menschen**. Test-Runs sind frei.

Details: `docs/01-challenge.md` §Fair Play.

## 3. Repo-Layout (Ist-Stand MVP, Commit auf `main`)

```
agent/                      # == eingereichtes Package (agent.json liegt HIER). Nur generischer Code!
  agent.json                # setup "uv sync --no-dev", run "uv run --no-sync python main.py", browsers 4, models ["qwen"]
  main.py                   # Einstieg: Run laden, 1 Browser je Site (Sandbox: CDP), Orchestrator, --dry-run/--out/--evidence
  rfq/contract.py           # Run-Contract (API / CHALLENGE_SCOUTING lokal), Uhr
  rfq/llm.py                # Qwen-Client: Retry, Timeouts, Semaphore, Thinking an/aus, JSON-Modus, Usage-Log
  rfq/log.py                # JSON-Zeilen auf stdout
  rfq/browser/observe.js    # DOM→Text-Serializer (Köder raus, Tooltips/details/Canvas rein, Refs)
  rfq/browser/guards.js     # Login-/Cookie-/Overlay-/Gate-/Fehlerseiten-Erkennung (generisch)
  rfq/browser/site.py       # Site = Website in einem Tab: Guards um jede Aktion, Popups, Relogin, Helper-Tabs, fill_fields
  rfq/agent/explorer.py     # LLM-Tool-Loop (1 Tool/Schritt), Fortschritts-Checkliste, Loop-Schutz
  rfq/agent/orchestrator.py # Brief → Missionen parallel (Tender, Spezifikation, Mail, ERP je Kataloggruppe) → Regeln → Abgabe
  rfq/agent/prompts.py      # System-Prompts + Extraktions-Schemata (site-agnostisch)
  rfq/agent/submit.py       # Abgabe-Agent: Formular, TAN aus Mail, Summary-Check, confirm()-Dialog
  rfq/rules/parse.py        # Zahlen (Locale), Daten, IDs
  rfq/rules/resolve.py      # Regeln + Pricing (Decimal, HALF_UP) mit Entscheidungs-Trace
  tests/                    # NUR synthetische Testdaten
dev/                        # NICHT eingereicht: Fixtures, Oracle, score.py, check_no_leaks.py, runs/
docs/                       # Wissensbasis (siehe Index)
(Root: agent.py/research.py/evidence.py/smoke/ = Tizians Starter-Kit-Prototyp, nicht Teil des Packages)
```

Einreichen/Testen immer aus `agent/`: `atira test-run ./agent`.
Alles mit Public-Werten (Fixtures, Oracle, Golden Answers) liegt ausschließlich in `dev/`.

## 4. Architektur (Kurzfassung — Details `docs/02-architecture.md`, Ist-Stand `docs/11-mvp-status.md`)

```
Brief ──► LLM-Extraktion (Referenz, Stichtag, Firma, USt-Id, Site-Rollen, autorisierte Absender je Thema)
   │
   ▼
Orchestrator (asyncio, Blackboard = append-only Extraktionen mit URL)
  ├─ Mission tender         (Browser 1)  → positions, clarifications
  ├─ Mission specification  (Browser 2)  → spec_revisions, requirements     ──┐
  ├─ Mission mail           (Browser 4)  → mail_list, mail_message           │
  └─ Missionen erp:<Gruppe> (Browser 3, je Kataloggruppe ein Tab) ◄─────────┘ (starten, sobald Spezifikation fertig)
       Explorer-Tools: click · type · select(+then_click) · fill_fields · check · set_slider · open_url · back
                       · read_all_pages(next_ref) · extract(kind) · extract_urls(urls, kind) · finish
       Fortschritts-Checkliste je Mission (vom Code aus dem Blackboard) → Auto-Finish, kein Wiederholen
   ▼
rules/resolve.py (deterministisch) → Answer + Trace → submit.py (Formular, TAN, confirm) 
```

Kernprinzipien:
- **LLM navigiert und interpretiert, Python rechnet.** Keine Arithmetik im LLM.
- **Observation = eigener DOM-Serializer** (a11y-basiert, alle Frames, Tooltips + geschlossene `<details>` sichtbar,
  `aria-hidden`/`display:none`-Köder raus, Canvas/`role=img` über `aria-label`, Zero-Width-Zeichen entfernt).
  Screenshots nur als Fallback für Vision (Qwen ist multimodal).
- **Jede Zahl hat Provenienz** (Quelle + Rohtext + Locale). Resolver wendet „neuester datierter Eintrag ≤ Stichtag,
  exakte Referenz, autorisierter Absender“ deterministisch an.
- **Immer eine Antwort abgeben.** Deadline-Wächter: spätestens bei `expires_at − 4 min` mit bestem Stand signieren.
  Leere Felder = 0 Punkte, falsche Felder = 0 Punkte → immer beste Schätzung eintragen, Positionen nie auslassen,
  außer sie lassen sich technisch nicht konfigurieren.

## 5. Workstreams & Branches (Details + Schnittstellen: `docs/07-workstreams.md`)

| Branch | Owner-Rolle | Liefert |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feat/agent-orchestrator` | Orchestrierung & LLM | `contract.py`, `llm/`, `agents/orchestrator.py`, `explorer.py`, Deadline, Logging, Package-Layout `agent/` |
| `feat/browser-tools` | Browser-Robustheit | `browser/*` (Serializer, Actions, Guards, Documents), Fixture-Tests gegen `dev/fixtures` |
| `feat/tender-specification` | Vergabe + Spezifikation | Missionen + Fact-Schemas für Tender, LV, Bieterfragen, Spezifikation/Revisionen, Nachträge |
| `feat/erp-mail-evidence` | ERP + Mail | Missionen + Fact-Schemas für Material/Bestand/Konditionen, Mail-Freigaben, Keys |
| `feat/pricing-submission` | Rechnen + Abgabe | `rules/*` (Parser, Resolver, Pricing, Validate), `submit/*` (Konfigurator, TAN) |

Schnittstelle zwischen Explorern und Regeln sind die Extraktions-Schemata `KINDS` in `agent/rfq/agent/prompts.py`
(Owner: pricing-submission + orchestrator; Änderungen per PR). Alle Branches bitte auf `main` rebasen — das MVP liegt dort.

## 6. Arbeitsweise

- Python 3.12, `uv`, asyncio, Playwright (async), `openai` SDK (für Qwen, OpenAI-kompatibel). Keine pydantic-Abhängigkeit (noch nicht nötig).
  Keine weiteren schweren Abhängigkeiten ohne Absprache (Setup max. 5 min, Package ≤ 20 MB).
- Geld & Mengen: **`decimal.Decimal`**, niemals `float`. Rundung `ROUND_HALF_UP` exakt dort, wo die Regeln es sagen.
- Zahlen/Datum immer über `rules/parse.py` (Locale-Tags `(de-DE)`/`(en-US)`, `(TT/MM)`/`(MM/TT)`, Zeitzonen).
- Logging: jede LLM-Antwort, jede Aktion, jeder Fact als JSON-Zeile auf stdout (die Plattform zeigt stdout im Run-Log).
  Keine Secrets loggen. Format: `{"t":…,"agent":…,"event":…,…}`.
- Prompts liegen in `agent/rfq/agent/prompts.py`, sind **site-agnostisch** und enthalten nur Regeln,
  Glossar und Vorgehen — nie Public-Werte.
- Kleine PRs, je Branch eigener Bereich; `facts.py` und Prompts nur per Review ändern.
- Commits: aussagekräftig, Englisch, Imperativ.

## 7. Testen (Details: `docs/06-testing.md`)

1. `cd agent && uv run pytest -q` — Unit-Tests (Parser, Pricing, Resolver, Serializer) mit synthetischen Daten.
2. `uv run pytest dev/tests -q` — Fixture-Tests gegen gespeichertes Public-HTML (Fallen-Regression).
3. Lokal End-to-End: Terminal 1 `atira models proxy`; Terminal 2 `eval "$(atira scout --env)" && cd agent && uv run python main.py`
   (lokal wird nichts gewertet; Abgabe mit Scouting-Logins wird „acknowledged“, zählt nie).
4. `uv run python dev/eval/score.py <answer.json>` — Feldweise Bewertung gegen `dev/oracle` (Punkteschema der Challenge).
5. Sandbox: `atira test-run ./agent` → Punkte je Feld; Debug über `atira mcp` (`diagnose_run`, `run_logs`, `run_screenshot`).
6. Robustheit: Perturbations-Tests (umbenannte Labels, andere Reihenfolge, andere Locale) — Ziel privater Datensatz.

**Definition of Done** für jedes Feature: Unit-Test grün · keine Public-Werte in `agent/` (`dev/check_no_leaks.py`) ·
läuft lokal gegen Scouting-Sites · Logs nachvollziehbar.

## 8. Doku-Index

| Datei | Inhalt |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/01-challenge.md` | Plattform, Run-Contract, Env-Variablen, Scoring, Fair Play, Answer-Schema, Abgabe-Ablauf |
| `docs/02-architecture.md` | Zielarchitektur, Datenfluss, Phasen, Zeitbudget, Modellstrategie |
| `docs/03-site-recon.md` | Was wir auf den 4 Public-Sites gefunden haben: jede Falle, generalisiert |
| `docs/04-business-rules.md` | Exakte Rechenregeln (alle 29), Formeln, Rundung, Reihenfolge, Edge Cases |
| `docs/05-browser-playbook.md` | Playwright-Regeln, Serializer-Spezifikation, Guards, Dialoge, Popups, Sessions |
| `docs/06-testing.md` | Teststrategie, Eval-Harness, Test-Runs, Debugging über MCP |
| `docs/07-workstreams.md` | Aufgaben je Person/Branch, Schnittstellen, Meilensteine |
| `docs/08-pitfalls.md` | Häufige Fehler (eigene Funde + Literatur) und Features, die wir übernehmen |
| `docs/09-glossary-de.md` | Deutsch-Glossar (für Runtime-Prompts geeignet, keine Szenario-Werte) |
| `docs/11-mvp-status.md` | Was funktioniert, Messwerte, offene Punkte, nächste Aufgaben je Person |
| `docs/10-risks-error-handling.md` | Fehlerbehandlung in Schichten, Deadline, LLM-/Browser-Edge-Cases, Review-Sicherheit |
| `docs/prompts/*.md` | Kickoff-Prompts je Workstream zum Einfügen in Codex/Claude |
| `docs/reference/` | Brief, Answer-Schema, Plattform-Docs (Snapshot) |

## F4 · Mail completion does not wait for newer records (base completed on a superseded approval) — reproducible from base.log
`mail_progress()` is complete when every wanted topic has ≥1 usable message, every **listed** message was opened, and every page of each
**listed** folder was read. In base, only the archive was ever listed (`archiv pages [1,2,3,4] of 4`). The inbox was never listed. The mission
completed at step 33 with the discount taken from `MSG-5285` (2027-01-18, 5 %). Newer discount mails were in the inbox and never opened:
`MSG-1750` (2027-01-22, **4 %**) and `conditional-7571` (2027-01-24, 5 % if the order value is ≥ 1.00 EUR, "earlier approvals do not revive").
Base scored 100 only because the newest record is also 5 % and its condition is met. With 4 % newest, or a condition not met (correct 0 %),
base would submit a wrong discount on every position.
Related: search-result lists are stored under their folder name. Reading all pages of `?folder=inbox&q=X` therefore makes the whole inbox count as read.
**Fix:** (a) Track folders seen as navigation links on the mail site (generic: folder links in the observation or the mail_list
extraction). Do not complete until each folder has been listed **or** searched with `<ref> <keyword>` for each wanted topic.
(b) Key the read pages by (folder, query), not by folder. (c) Before completing, require per topic either a full read of the folder list or a
`<ref> <keyword>` search in each folder, and open every hit dated ≤ the cut-off date. Then "newest ≤ cut-off" is actually decidable.

## F5 · `done` is accepted while the checklist is incomplete (Scout never postpones) — reproducible
Scout runs every extraction synchronously, so `self.pending` is always empty. The "postpone finish" branch therefore never fires. A bare
`{"a":"done"}` with an open checklist returns `status="finished"` with `missing=[]` (repro test). Effect: s2 ERP stopped at step 23 and mail at step 30
while their checklists were open. Each mission then needed a full classic retry.
**Fix:** if the checklist is incomplete and `missing` is empty, reject the first `done`: return "checklist still open: <first open lines>".
Accept a second `done` only with an explicit `missing` list.

## F6 · Material status from a sub-view overwrites the real status (s1 = 10/100 root cause) — evidence in s1.log
On the retry (classic Explorer), s1 extracted `mmbe?…&level=inspection` for 4 materials at t=211–213 s. That page produced
`status_code 0099 / blocked` for HZ-2170 and HZ-3916, which are active in the planning tab of the same run (t=172 s) and in base.
`Orchestrator.materials()` merges with last-non-empty-wins, so HZ-2170 became blocked. Result: "no active matching material for
01.02/01.03/01.04" → no_bid → 10/100. Scout did not cause this directly, but its mail/ERP aborts led to the retry that opened those pages.
**Fix:** keep stock/inspection blocking apart from material status. Only accept `status_meaning` from an extraction that also has a
`status_code`, and flag conflicting statuses as `[ ] status conflict: active (url A) vs blocked (url B)` in `erp_progress`, so they are not
merged silently. A resolver unit test with two conflicting extractions would catch a regression.

## Minor
- `open` without `kind` → `ERROR: unknown kind None` (s2 ERP step 16, 4 URLs wasted). If the mission has exactly one kind, default to it.
- Repeated `extract_urls` on already-extracted URLs (s2 ERP: 90 for 62 distinct) still calls `read_url` before the extractor cache.
  Check the cache key (url, kind) before loading the page.
- s1 used an older scout.py (searches went through `_extraction`/background). Its timings are also distorted by the proxy outage, so do not
  compare its speed with s2.

## Suggested order before spending sandbox runs
F1 + F2 + F3 (cheap, cause most of the repeated mail/ERP calls) → F5 → F4 → F6. All can be checked offline with the fake-portal
replay. None needs a backend run.

"""A stuck model request gets a twin after a while; the first answer wins, nothing is left running."""
import asyncio
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from rfq import llm


def _client(create):
    return SimpleNamespace(chat=SimpleNamespace(completions=SimpleNamespace(create=create)))


def _response(text="{}"):
    return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(message=SimpleNamespace(content=text, tool_calls=[]))], usage=None)


@pytest.fixture
def fast_hedge(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "HEDGE_AFTER", {True: 0.1, False: 0.1})
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_recent", {True: [], False: []})
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_hedging", 0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_slots", asyncio.Semaphore(2))
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_run_deadline", float("inf"))


def _install(monkeypatch, *behaviours):
    """Request i behaves like behaviours[i]: ('hang',), ('answer', delay) or ('fail', delay)."""
    started, cancelled = [], []

    async def create(**kwargs):
        index = len(started)
        started.append(index)
        kind, *rest = behaviours[min(index, len(behaviours) - 1)]
        try:
            if kind == "hang":
                await asyncio.Event().wait()
            await asyncio.sleep(rest[0])
            if kind == "fail":
                raise RuntimeError("503 from the proxy")
            return _response(f'{{"by": {index}}}')
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            cancelled.append(index)
            raise
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "client", lambda: _client(create))
    return started, cancelled


def test_a_stuck_request_is_answered_by_its_twin(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    started, cancelled = _install(monkeypatch, ("hang",), ("answer", 0.05))

    async def scenario():
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        reply = await llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 60)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        return reply, time.monotonic() - t0
    reply, seconds = asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert reply["content"] == '{"by": 1}' and seconds < 1.0
    assert started == [0, 1] and cancelled == [0] and llm._hedging == 0


def test_a_normal_request_gets_no_twin(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    started, _ = _install(monkeypatch, ("answer", 0.01))
    asyncio.run(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 60))
    assert started == [0]


def test_twins_are_bounded(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_hedging", llm.MAX_HEDGES)       # other twins are already running
    started, _ = _install(monkeypatch, ("answer", 0.3))
    reply = asyncio.run(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 60))
    assert started == [0] and reply["content"] == '{"by": 0}'


def test_the_twin_wins_when_the_first_request_fails_late(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    started, _ = _install(monkeypatch, ("fail", 0.2), ("answer", 0.2))
    reply = asyncio.run(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 60))
    assert reply["content"] == '{"by": 1}' and started == [0, 1]


def test_cancelling_a_hedged_call_cancels_both_requests_and_frees_the_slot(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    started, cancelled = _install(monkeypatch, ("hang",), ("hang",))

    async def scenario():
        task = asyncio.create_task(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 60))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        task.cancel()
        with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        await asyncio.wait_for(llm._slots.acquire(), 0.1)      # both slots are free again
        await asyncio.wait_for(llm._slots.acquire(), 0.1)
    asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert sorted(cancelled) == [0, 1] and llm._hedging == 0


def test_thinking_calls_are_not_hedged(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    started, _ = _install(monkeypatch, ("answer", 0.3))
    asyncio.run(llm.chat([], thinking=True, deadline=time.time() + 60))
    assert started == [0]


def test_a_short_model_outage_is_waited_out(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    """Fake portal legacy/blocked: the model proxy answered 502 for a while and the submission gave up after six
    attempts with minutes left. Service errors are retried while the deadline allows; refused requests are not."""
    class Unavailable(Exception):
        status_code = 502

    class Refused(Exception):
        status_code = 400

    calls = []

    async def create(**kwargs):
        calls.append(1)
        if len(calls) <= 8:
            raise Unavailable("Cannot reach the platform")
        return _response('{"ok": true}')

    async def no_wait(seconds):
        return None

    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "client", lambda: _client(create))
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm.asyncio, "sleep", no_wait)
    reply = asyncio.run(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 120))
    assert reply["content"] == '{"ok": true}' and len(calls) == 9

    refused = []

    async def create_refused(**kwargs):
        refused.append(1)
        raise Refused("context too long")

    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "client", lambda: _client(create_refused))
    with pytest.raises(llm.DeadlineExceeded):
        asyncio.run(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 120))
    assert len(refused) == 3

"""A stuck model request gets a twin after a while; the first answer wins, nothing is left running."""
import asyncio
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from rfq import llm


def _client(create):
    return SimpleNamespace(chat=SimpleNamespace(completions=SimpleNamespace(create=create)))


def _response(text="{}"):
    return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(message=SimpleNamespace(content=text, tool_calls=[]))], usage=None)


@pytest.fixture
def fast_hedge(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "HEDGE_AFTER", {True: 0.1, False: 0.1})
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_recent", {True: [], False: []})
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_hedging", 0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_slots", asyncio.Semaphore(2))
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_run_deadline", float("inf"))


def _install(monkeypatch, *behaviours):
    """Request i behaves like behaviours[i]: ('hang',), ('answer', delay) or ('fail', delay)."""
    started, cancelled = [], []

    async def create(**kwargs):
        index = len(started)
        started.append(index)
        kind, *rest = behaviours[min(index, len(behaviours) - 1)]
        try:
            if kind == "hang":
                await asyncio.Event().wait()
            await asyncio.sleep(rest[0])
            if kind == "fail":
                raise RuntimeError("503 from the proxy")
            return _response(f'{{"by": {index}}}')
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            cancelled.append(index)
            raise
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "client", lambda: _client(create))
    return started, cancelled


def test_a_stuck_request_is_answered_by_its_twin(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    started, cancelled = _install(monkeypatch, ("hang",), ("answer", 0.05))

    async def scenario():
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        reply = await llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 60)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        return reply, time.monotonic() - t0
    reply, seconds = asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert reply["content"] == '{"by": 1}' and seconds < 1.0
    assert started == [0, 1] and cancelled == [0] and llm._hedging == 0


def test_a_normal_request_gets_no_twin(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    started, _ = _install(monkeypatch, ("answer", 0.01))
    asyncio.run(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 60))
    assert started == [0]


def test_twins_are_bounded(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "_hedging", llm.MAX_HEDGES)       # other twins are already running
    started, _ = _install(monkeypatch, ("answer", 0.3))
    reply = asyncio.run(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 60))
    assert started == [0] and reply["content"] == '{"by": 0}'


def test_the_twin_wins_when_the_first_request_fails_late(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    started, _ = _install(monkeypatch, ("fail", 0.2), ("answer", 0.2))
    reply = asyncio.run(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 60))
    assert reply["content"] == '{"by": 1}' and started == [0, 1]


def test_cancelling_a_hedged_call_cancels_both_requests_and_frees_the_slot(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    started, cancelled = _install(monkeypatch, ("hang",), ("hang",))

    async def scenario():
        task = asyncio.create_task(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 60))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        task.cancel()
        with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        await asyncio.wait_for(llm._slots.acquire(), 0.1)      # both slots are free again
        await asyncio.wait_for(llm._slots.acquire(), 0.1)
    asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert sorted(cancelled) == [0, 1] and llm._hedging == 0


def test_thinking_calls_are_not_hedged(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    started, _ = _install(monkeypatch, ("answer", 0.3))
    asyncio.run(llm.chat([], thinking=True, deadline=time.time() + 60))
    assert started == [0]


def test_a_short_model_outage_is_waited_out(monkeypatch, fast_hedge):
    """Fake portal legacy/blocked: the model proxy answered 502 for a while and the submission gave up after six
    attempts with minutes left. Service errors are retried while the deadline allows; refused requests are not."""
    class Unavailable(Exception):
        status_code = 502

    class Refused(Exception):
        status_code = 400

    calls = []

    async def create(**kwargs):
        calls.append(1)
        if len(calls) <= 8:
            raise Unavailable("Cannot reach the platform")
        return _response('{"ok": true}')

    async def no_wait(seconds):
        return None

    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "client", lambda: _client(create))
    monkeypatch.setattr(llm.asyncio, "sleep", no_wait)
    reply = asyncio.run(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 120))
    assert reply["content"] == '{"ok": true}' and len(calls) == 9

    refused = []

    async def create_refused(**kwargs):
        refused.append(1)
        raise Refused("context too long")

    monkeypatch.setattr(llm, "client", lambda: _client(create_refused))
    with pytest.raises(llm.DeadlineExceeded):
        asyncio.run(llm.chat([], deadline=time.time() + 120))
    assert len(refused) == 3

"""Model access: the hosted Qwen through the run's metering proxy (OpenAI-compatible).

Every call is retried on transient failures, limited by a semaphore (the team shares 32 Qwen slots across all runs)
and logged with tokens and latency. `thinking=False` turns Qwen's reasoning off: about 3x faster for navigation.
All waiting (semaphore, request, retry pauses) is bounded by a deadline: the caller's, and never later than the run's.
"""
import asyncio
import base64
import json
import os
import re
import time

from openai import AsyncOpenAI

from .log import log

MODEL = os.environ.get("RFQ_MODEL", "qwen3.8-flash-next")
_client: AsyncOpenAI | None = None
_slots = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("RFQ_LLM_PARALLEL", "8")))
_interactive = asyncio.Semaphore(4)
_background = asyncio.Semaphore(4)
usage = {"calls": 0, "input": 0, "cached": 0, "output": 0, "seconds": 0.0, "images": 0, "hedges": 0}
_run_deadline = float("inf")   # epoch seconds; set by the orchestrator
# Hedged requests ("The Tail at Scale", Dean & Barroso 2013): a request that is still silent long after a normal one
# would have answered is probably stuck in a queue, so an identical twin is sent and the first answer wins.
# Measured over 3,000+ calls of our runs: tool calls p50 2.2 s / p99 9.7 s, JSON extractions p50 7.9 s / p99 30 s;
# a stuck request otherwise blocks a mission for the full per-call timeout (60 s / 150 s).
HEDGE_AFTER = {True: 12.0, False: 30.0}   # tools / no tools; slower when recent calls are slower (3x their median)
MAX_HEDGES = int(os.environ.get("RFQ_LLM_HEDGES", "0"))
_hedging = 0
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 60   # a model outage of a few minutes must not end a mission: 5xx, 429, timeouts are retried (≤ 8 s apart)
QUIET_CALLS = bool(os.environ.get("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN"))   # in a run the platform keeps only the end of the log
_recent: dict[bool, list[float]] = {True: [], False: []}


class DeadlineExceeded(RuntimeError):
    """Not enough time left for a model call."""


def set_run_deadline(epoch_seconds: float) -> None:
    global _run_deadline
    _run_deadline = epoch_seconds


def client() -> AsyncOpenAI:
    global _client
    if _client is None:
        _client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"],
                              timeout=float(os.environ.get("RFQ_LLM_TIMEOUT", "180")), max_retries=0)
    return _client


async def chat(messages: list[dict], *, tools: list[dict] | None = None, thinking: bool = False,
               json_mode: bool = False, temperature: float = 0.1, tag: str = "", timeout: float | None = None,
               deadline: float | None = None, max_tokens: int | None = None) -> dict:
    """One chat completion; returns {"content": str, "tool_calls": [(name, args_dict)]}.
    Raises DeadlineExceeded when the deadline does not leave room for another attempt."""
    kwargs: dict = {"model": MODEL, "messages": messages, "temperature": temperature,
                    "extra_body": {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": thinking}}}
    if tools:
        kwargs["tools"] = tools
        kwargs["tool_choice"] = "required"
    if json_mode:
        kwargs["response_format"] = {"type": "json_object"}
    if max_tokens:
        kwargs["max_tokens"] = max_tokens
    end = min(deadline or float("inf"), _run_deadline)
    per_call = timeout or (60 if tools else 150)   # a hung call must not eat minutes
    delay, refusals = 1.0, 0
    for attempt in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):     # transient failures are retried while the deadline allows
        left = end - time.time()
        if left < 3:
            log("llm_deadline", tag=tag, attempt=attempt)
            raise DeadlineExceeded(tag)
        started = time.monotonic()
        slots = _slots
        lane = _background if tag.startswith(("extract", "brief", "vision", "submit:")) else _interactive
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(lane.acquire(), timeout=left - 2)
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(slots.acquire(), timeout=max(.1, end - time.time() - 2))
            except BaseException:
                lane.release()
                raise
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            log("llm_deadline", tag=tag, attempt=attempt, waiting="slot")
            raise DeadlineExceeded(tag)
        try:
            try:
                requested = time.monotonic()
                response = await _first_answer(kwargs, per_call, end, None if thinking else _hedge_after(bool(tools)), tag)
                _recent[bool(tools)][:] = _recent[bool(tools)][-29:] + [time.monotonic() - requested]
            finally:
                slots.release()
                lane.release()
        except Exception as error:
            log("llm_error", tag=tag, attempt=attempt, error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
            status = getattr(error, "status_code", None)
            # Refusals: the request (400/413/422) or the access (401/403, e.g. the run token after the accepted
            # answer). A proxy in trouble also answers 403 once in a while, so only the third refusal in a row ends
            # the call; 404/409/429/5xx and timeouts are hiccups and are retried while the deadline allows.
            refusals = refusals + 1 if status in (400, 401, 403, 413, 422) else 0
            if refusals >= 3:
                raise DeadlineExceeded(f"{tag}: request refused ({status})")
            await asyncio.sleep(max(0.0, min(delay, end - time.time() - 3)))
            delay = min(delay * 2, 8)
            continue
        seconds = time.monotonic() - started
        message = response.choices[0].message
        tokens = response.usage
        cached = getattr(getattr(tokens, "prompt_tokens_details", None), "cached_tokens", 0) or 0 if tokens else 0
        usage["seconds"] += seconds
        calls = []
        for call in message.tool_calls or []:
            calls.append((call.function.name, _loads(call.function.arguments) or {}))
        if tools and not calls:  # some replies put the call into the text
            calls = _calls_from_text(message.content or "")
        log("llm", tag=tag, s=round(seconds, 2),
            tokens=[getattr(tokens, "prompt_tokens", None), getattr(tokens, "completion_tokens", None), cached])
        return {"content": message.content or "", "tool_calls": calls}
    raise DeadlineExceeded(f"LLM unavailable after retries ({tag})")


def _hedge_after(tools: bool) -> float:
    recent = sorted(_recent[tools])
    typical = recent[len(recent) // 2] if len(recent) >= 5 else 0.0
    return max(HEDGE_AFTER[tools], 3 * typical)


async def _request(kwargs: dict, timeout: float):
    usage["attempts"] = usage.get("attempts", 0) + 1
    response = await client().chat.completions.create(**kwargs, timeout=timeout)
    tokens = response.usage
    if tokens:
        usage["input"] += tokens.prompt_tokens or 0
        usage["output"] += tokens.completion_tokens or 0
        usage["cached"] += getattr(getattr(tokens, "prompt_tokens_details", None), "cached_tokens", 0) or 0
    usage["calls"] += 1
    return response


async def _first_answer(kwargs: dict, per_call: float, end: float, hedge_after: float | None, tag: str):
    """The first successful answer of the request or, when it stays silent for `hedge_after` seconds, of its twin.
    The other request is cancelled. Errors are raised only when every request failed."""
    global _hedging
    if hedge_after is not None and hedge_after >= per_call - 5:
        hedge_after = None                          # the request's own timeout comes first
    tasks = [asyncio.ensure_future(_request(kwargs, max(2.0, min(per_call, end - time.time()))))]
    twin = False
    try:
        done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=hedge_after)
        if hedge_after is not None and not done and _hedging < MAX_HEDGES and end - time.time() > 10:
            _hedging += 1
            twin = True
            usage["hedges"] += 1
            log("llm_hedge", tag=tag, after=round(hedge_after, 1))
            tasks.append(asyncio.ensure_future(_request(kwargs, max(2.0, min(per_call, end - time.time())))))
        pending, error = set(tasks), None
        while pending:
            done, pending = await asyncio.wait(pending, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
            for task in done:
                if task.exception() is None:
                    if twin:
                        log("llm_hedge_won", tag=tag, by="twin" if task is tasks[-1] else "first")
                    return task.result()
                error = task.exception()
        raise error
    finally:
        if twin:
            _hedging -= 1
        for task in tasks:
            if not task.done():
                task.cancel()
            elif not task.cancelled():
                task.exception()   # a failed loser: retrieved, no warning
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)


async def ask_json(system: str, user: str | list, *, thinking: bool = False, tag: str = "",
                   deadline: float | None = None, max_tokens: int | None = None) -> dict:
    """A JSON object from the model; one repair round if the reply does not parse. `user` may be multimodal parts."""
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
    for attempt in range(2):
        reply = await chat(messages, thinking=thinking, json_mode=True, temperature=0, tag=tag, deadline=deadline,
                           max_tokens=max_tokens * (attempt + 1) if max_tokens else None)
        data = _loads(reply["content"])
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
        messages += [{"role": "assistant", "content": reply["content"][:2000]},
                     {"role": "user", "content": "That was not one valid JSON object. Reply with the JSON object only."}]
    log("llm_json_failed", tag=tag)
    return {}


def image_part(jpeg: bytes) -> dict:
    """An image content part (OpenAI format) for multimodal messages."""
    usage["images"] += 1
    return {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpeg).decode()}}


def _loads(text: str | None):
    if not text:
        return None
    text = text.strip()
    text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*|\s*```$", "", text)
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except ValueError:
        match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", text, re.S)
        if match:
            try:
                return json.loads(match.group(0))
            except ValueError:
                return None
    return None


def _calls_from_text(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    data = _loads(text)
    if isinstance(data, dict) and isinstance(data.get("name"), str):
        return [(data["name"], data.get("arguments") or data.get("args") or {})]
    return []

import os

import time

from openai import AsyncOpenAI

from .log import log

MODEL = os.environ.get("RFQ_MODEL", "qwen3.8-flash-next")

_slots = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("RFQ_LLM_PARALLEL", "8")))
_interactive = asyncio.Semaphore(4)
_background = asyncio.Semaphore(4)
usage = {"calls": 0, "input": 0, "cached": 0, "output": 0, "seconds": 0.0, "images": 0, "hedges": 0}
_run_deadline = float("inf")   # epoch seconds; set by the orchestrator
# Hedged requests ("The Tail at Scale", Dean & Barroso 2013): a request that is still silent long after a normal one
# would have answered is probably stuck in a queue, so an identical twin is sent and the first answer wins.
# Measured over 3,000+ calls of our runs: tool calls p50 2.2 s / p99 9.7 s, JSON extractions p50 7.9 s / p99 30 s;
# a stuck request otherwise blocks a mission for the full per-call timeout (60 s / 150 s).
HEDGE_AFTER = {True: 12.0, False: 30.0}   # tools / no tools; slower when recent calls are slower (3x their median)
MAX_HEDGES = int(os.environ.get("RFQ_LLM_HEDGES", "0"))
_hedging = 0
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 60   # a model outage of a few minutes must not end a mission: 5xx, 429, timeouts are retried (≤ 8 s apart)
QUIET_CALLS = bool(os.environ.get("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN"))   # in a run the platform keeps only the end of the log
_recent: dict[bool, list[float]] = {True: [], False: []}


class DeadlineExceeded(RuntimeError):

    global _client
    if _client is None:
        _client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"],
                              timeout=float(os.environ.get("RFQ_LLM_TIMEOUT", "180")), max_retries=0)
    return _client

"""Model access: the hosted Qwen through the run's metering proxy (OpenAI-compatible).

Every call is retried on transient failures, limited by a semaphore (the team shares 32 Qwen slots across all runs)
and logged with tokens and latency. `thinking=False` turns Qwen's reasoning off: about 3x faster for navigation.
All waiting (semaphore, request, retry pauses) is bounded by a deadline: the caller's, and never later than the run's.
"""
import asyncio
import base64
import json
import os
import re
import time

from openai import AsyncOpenAI

from .log import log

MODEL = os.environ.get("RFQ_MODEL", "qwen3.8-flash-next")
_client: AsyncOpenAI | None = None
_slots = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("RFQ_LLM_PARALLEL", "8")))
_interactive = asyncio.Semaphore(4)
_background = asyncio.Semaphore(4)
usage = {"calls": 0, "input": 0, "cached": 0, "output": 0, "seconds": 0.0, "images": 0, "hedges": 0}
_run_deadline = float("inf")   # epoch seconds; set by the orchestrator
# Hedged requests ("The Tail at Scale", Dean & Barroso 2013): a request that is still silent long after a normal one
# would have answered is probably stuck in a queue, so an identical twin is sent and the first answer wins.
# Measured over 3,000+ calls of our runs: tool calls p50 2.2 s / p99 9.7 s, JSON extractions p50 7.9 s / p99 30 s;
# a stuck request otherwise blocks a mission for the full per-call timeout (60 s / 150 s).
HEDGE_AFTER = {True: 12.0, False: 30.0}   # tools / no tools; slower when recent calls are slower (3x their median)
MAX_HEDGES = int(os.environ.get("RFQ_LLM_HEDGES", "0"))
_hedging = 0
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 60   # a model outage of a few minutes must not end a mission: 5xx, 429, timeouts are retried (≤ 8 s apart)
QUIET_CALLS = bool(os.environ.get("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN"))   # in a run the platform keeps only the end of the log
_recent: dict[bool, list[float]] = {True: [], False: []}


class DeadlineExceeded(RuntimeError):
    """Not enough time left for a model call."""


def set_run_deadline(epoch_seconds: float) -> None:
    global _run_deadline
    _run_deadline = epoch_seconds


def client() -> AsyncOpenAI:
    global _client
    if _client is None:
        _client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"],
                              timeout=float(os.environ.get("RFQ_LLM_TIMEOUT", "180")), max_retries=0)
    return _client


async def chat(messages: list[dict], *, tools: list[dict] | None = None, thinking: bool = False,
               json_mode: bool = False, temperature: float = 0.1, tag: str = "", timeout: float | None = None,
               deadline: float | None = None, max_tokens: int | None = None) -> dict:
    """One chat completion; returns {"content": str, "tool_calls": [(name, args_dict)]}.
    Raises DeadlineExceeded when the deadline does not leave room for another attempt."""
    kwargs: dict = {"model": MODEL, "messages": messages, "temperature": temperature,
                    "extra_body": {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": thinking}}}
    if tools:
        kwargs["tools"] = tools
        kwargs["tool_choice"] = "required"
    if json_mode:
        kwargs["response_format"] = {"type": "json_object"}
    if max_tokens:
        kwargs["max_tokens"] = max_tokens
    end = min(deadline or float("inf"), _run_deadline)
    per_call = timeout or (60 if tools else 150)   # a hung call must not eat minutes
    delay, refusals = 1.0, 0
    for attempt in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):     # transient failures are retried while the deadline allows
        left = end - time.time()
        if left < 3:
            log("llm_deadline", tag=tag, attempt=attempt)
            raise DeadlineExceeded(tag)
        started = time.monotonic()
        slots = _slots
        lane = _background if tag.startswith(("extract", "brief", "vision", "submit:")) else _interactive
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(lane.acquire(), timeout=left - 2)
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(slots.acquire(), timeout=max(.1, end - time.time() - 2))
            except BaseException:
                lane.release()
                raise
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            log("llm_deadline", tag=tag, attempt=attempt, waiting="slot")
            raise DeadlineExceeded(tag)
        try:
            try:
                requested = time.monotonic()
                response = await _first_answer(kwargs, per_call, end, None if thinking else _hedge_after(bool(tools)), tag)
                _recent[bool(tools)][:] = _recent[bool(tools)][-29:] + [time.monotonic() - requested]
            finally:
                slots.release()
                lane.release()
        except Exception as error:
            log("llm_error", tag=tag, attempt=attempt, error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
            status = getattr(error, "status_code", None)
            # Refusals: the request (400/413/422) or the access (401/403, e.g. the run token after the accepted
            # answer). A proxy in trouble also answers 403 once in a while, so only the third refusal in a row ends
            # the call; 404/409/429/5xx and timeouts are hiccups and are retried while the deadline allows.
            refusals = refusals + 1 if status in (400, 401, 403, 413, 422) else 0
            if refusals >= 3:
                raise DeadlineExceeded(f"{tag}: request refused ({status})")
            await asyncio.sleep(max(0.0, min(delay, end - time.time() - 3)))
            delay = min(delay * 2, 8)
            continue
        seconds = time.monotonic() - started
        message = response.choices[0].message
        tokens = response.usage
        cached = getattr(getattr(tokens, "prompt_tokens_details", None), "cached_tokens", 0) or 0 if tokens else 0
        usage["seconds"] += seconds
        calls = []
        for call in message.tool_calls or []:
            calls.append((call.function.name, _loads(call.function.arguments) or {}))
        if tools and not calls:  # some replies put the call into the text
            calls = _calls_from_text(message.content or "")
        log("llm", tag=tag, s=round(seconds, 2),
            tokens=[getattr(tokens, "prompt_tokens", None), getattr(tokens, "completion_tokens", None), cached])
        return {"content": message.content or "", "tool_calls": calls}
    raise DeadlineExceeded(f"LLM unavailable after retries ({tag})")


def _hedge_after(tools: bool) -> float:
    recent = sorted(_recent[tools])
    typical = recent[len(recent) // 2] if len(recent) >= 5 else 0.0
    return max(HEDGE_AFTER[tools], 3 * typical)


async def _request(kwargs: dict, timeout: float):
    usage["attempts"] = usage.get("attempts", 0) + 1
    response = await client().chat.completions.create(**kwargs, timeout=timeout)
    tokens = response.usage
    if tokens:
        usage["input"] += tokens.prompt_tokens or 0
        usage["output"] += tokens.completion_tokens or 0
        usage["cached"] += getattr(getattr(tokens, "prompt_tokens_details", None), "cached_tokens", 0) or 0
    usage["calls"] += 1
    return response


async def _first_answer(kwargs: dict, per_call: float, end: float, hedge_after: float | None, tag: str):
    """The first successful answer of the request or, when it stays silent for `hedge_after` seconds, of its twin.
    The other request is cancelled. Errors are raised only when every request failed."""
    global _hedging
    if hedge_after is not None and hedge_after >= per_call - 5:
        hedge_after = None                          # the request's own timeout comes first
    tasks = [asyncio.ensure_future(_request(kwargs, max(2.0, min(per_call, end - time.time()))))]
    twin = False
    try:
        done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=hedge_after)
        if hedge_after is not None and not done and _hedging < MAX_HEDGES and end - time.time() > 10:
            _hedging += 1
            twin = True
            usage["hedges"] += 1
            log("llm_hedge", tag=tag, after=round(hedge_after, 1))
            tasks.append(asyncio.ensure_future(_request(kwargs, max(2.0, min(per_call, end - time.time())))))
        pending, error = set(tasks), None
        while pending:
            done, pending = await asyncio.wait(pending, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
            for task in done:
                if task.exception() is None:
                    if twin:
                        log("llm_hedge_won", tag=tag, by="twin" if task is tasks[-1] else "first")
                    return task.result()
                error = task.exception()
        raise error
    finally:
        if twin:
            _hedging -= 1
        for task in tasks:
            if not task.done():
                task.cancel()
            elif not task.cancelled():
                task.exception()   # a failed loser: retrieved, no warning
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)


async def ask_json(system: str, user: str | list, *, thinking: bool = False, tag: str = "",
                   deadline: float | None = None, max_tokens: int | None = None) -> dict:
    """A JSON object from the model; one repair round if the reply does not parse. `user` may be multimodal parts."""
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
    for attempt in range(2):
        reply = await chat(messages, thinking=thinking, json_mode=True, temperature=0, tag=tag, deadline=deadline,
                           max_tokens=max_tokens * (attempt + 1) if max_tokens else None)
        data = _loads(reply["content"])
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
        messages += [{"role": "assistant", "content": reply["content"][:2000]},
                     {"role": "user", "content": "That was not one valid JSON object. Reply with the JSON object only."}]
    log("llm_json_failed", tag=tag)
    return {}


def image_part(jpeg: bytes) -> dict:
    """An image content part (OpenAI format) for multimodal messages."""
    usage["images"] += 1
    return {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpeg).decode()}}


def _loads(text: str | None):
    if not text:
        return None
    text = text.strip()
    text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*|\s*```$", "", text)
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except ValueError:
        match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", text, re.S)
        if match:
            try:
                return json.loads(match.group(0))
            except ValueError:
                return None
    return None


def _calls_from_text(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    data = _loads(text)
    if isinstance(data, dict) and isinstance(data.get("name"), str):
        return [(data["name"], data.get("arguments") or data.get("args") or {})]
    return []

+            continue

+        end = max(end, stop)
+    return round(total, 6)
+
+
+def gaps(intervals: list[tuple[float, float]], stop: float) -> list[list[float]]:
+    """Observed gaps in this instrumentation, not proof that the process was idle."""
+    result, cursor = [], 0.0
+    for start, end in sorted(intervals):
+        if start > cursor:
+            result.append([round(cursor, 6), round(min(start, stop), 6)])
+        cursor = max(cursor, end)
+    if stop > cursor:
+        result.append([round(cursor, 6), round(stop, 6)])
+    return sorted((gap for gap in result if gap[1] > gap[0]),
+                  key=lambda gap: gap[1] - gap[0], reverse=True)
+
+
+def token_ledger(events: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    usages = [event for event in events if event.get("event") == "profile_usage"]
+    explicit = bool(usages)
+    if not explicit:
+        usages = [{"input_tokens": event["tokens"][0], "output_tokens": event["tokens"][1],
+                   "cached_tokens": event["tokens"][2], "known": event["tokens"][0] is not None,
+                   "reasoning_in_output": True, "reasoning_tokens": 0}
+                  for event in events if event.get("event") == "llm"
+                  and isinstance(event.get("tokens"), list) and len(event["tokens"]) == 3]
+    totals = Counter()
+    seen = {}
+    for usage in usages:
+        attempt = usage.get("attempt_id")
+        if attempt is not None and attempt in seen:
+            if seen[attempt] != usage:
+                raise ValueError(f"conflicting metering for attempt {attempt}")
+            continue
+        if attempt is not None:
+            seen[attempt] = usage
+        totals["attempts"] += 1
+        if not usage.get("known", False):
+            totals["unknown_usage_attempts"] += 1
+            continue
+        incoming, outgoing = usage.get("input_tokens"), usage.get("output_tokens")
+        cached, reasoning = usage.get("cached_tokens"), usage.get("reasoning_tokens", 0)
+        if incoming is None or outgoing is None:
+            raise ValueError("known usage lacks token counts")
+        if min(incoming, outgoing, reasoning) < 0 or (cached is not None and not 0 <= cached <= incoming):
+            raise ValueError("invalid token counts")
+        totals["input_tokens"] += incoming
+        totals["output_tokens"] += outgoing
+        totals["cached_tokens"] += cached or 0
+        totals["reasoning_tokens"] += reasoning
+        separately_metered = reasoning if not usage.get("reasoning_in_output", True) else 0
+        total = incoming + outgoing + separately_metered
+        totals["total_tokens"] += total
+        if usage.get("speculative"):
+            totals["speculative_tokens"] += total
+    fields = ("attempts", "unknown_usage_attempts", "input_tokens", "output_tokens",
+              "cached_tokens", "reasoning_tokens", "speculative_tokens", "total_tokens")
+    return {**{field: totals[field] for field in fields},
+            "coverage": "all instrumented attempts" if explicit else "legacy successful winners only",
+            "complete": explicit and totals["unknown_usage_attempts"] == 0}
+
+
+def span_ledger(events: list[dict], wall_seconds: float | None = None) -> dict:
+    spans = [event for event in events if event.get("event") == "profile_span"]
+    groups, intervals = defaultdict(list), []
+    for event in spans:
+        start, seconds = float(event["start"]), float(event["seconds"])
+        if start < 0 or seconds < 0:
+            raise ValueError("invalid span timing")
+        interval = (start, start + seconds)
+        intervals.append(interval)
+        groups[event.get("category") or event["name"]].append(interval)
+    stop = wall_seconds if wall_seconds is not None else max((end for _, end in intervals), default=0)
+    category = {name: {"count": len(values),
+                       "summed_seconds": round(sum(end - start for start, end in values), 6),
+                       "union_seconds": union_seconds(values)} for name, values in sorted(groups.items())}
+    slow = sorted(spans, key=lambda event: event["seconds"], reverse=True)[:20]
+    return {"spans": len(spans), "wall_seconds": stop, "categories": category,
+            "uninstrumented_gaps": gaps(intervals, stop),
+            "slowest_spans": [{key: event.get(key) for key in
+                               ("id", "parent", "name", "agent", "category", "start", "seconds", "status")}
+                              for event in slow],
+            "note": "Summed times overlap. Union times are occupied wall time; gaps are not proof of idle time."}
+
+
+def platform_snapshots(texts: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
+    snapshots = []
+    pattern = re.compile(r"LLM: ([\d,]+) calls, \$([\d.]+), ([\d,]+) in / ([\d,]+) out tokens")
+    for text in texts:
+        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
+            calls, cost, incoming, outgoing = match.groups()
+            cache = re.search(r"in \(([\d,]+) cached\)", text)
+            snapshot = {"calls": int(calls.replace(",", "")), "cost_usd": cost,
+                        "input_tokens": int(incoming.replace(",", "")),
+                        "output_tokens": int(outgoing.replace(",", ""))}
+            snapshot["total_tokens"] = snapshot["input_tokens"] + snapshot["output_tokens"]
+            snapshot["cached_tokens"] = int(cache[1].replace(",", "")) if cache else None
+            snapshot["running_snapshot"] = "Status running" in text
+            snapshots.append(snapshot)
+    return snapshots
+
+
+def analyze(paths: list[Path], *, seconds: float | None = None, cost: str | None = None,
+            leader_cost: str = "0.02583", leader_seconds: str = "38.259") -> dict:
+    captures = [read_capture(path) for path in paths]
+    events = [event for captured, _ in captures for event in captured]
+    ledger = token_ledger(events)
+    snapshots = platform_snapshots([text for _, text in captures])
+    lower_bound = max([ledger["total_tokens"]] + [snapshot["total_tokens"] for snapshot in snapshots])
+    report = {"tokens": ledger, "platform_snapshots": snapshots,
+              "observed_token_lower_bound": lower_bound,
+              "within_200k": False if lower_bound > 200_000 else (True if ledger["complete"] else None),
+              "timing": span_ledger(events, seconds),
+              "actions": dict(Counter(event.get("tool", "unknown") for event in events
+                                      if event.get("event") == "action")),
+              "budget_note": "Use final platform totals for acceptance; cached input is included once. "
+                             "Cancelled/unmetered requests and incomplete captures prevent a passing claim."}
+    if seconds is not None and cost is not None:
+        product = Decimal(cost) * Decimal(str(seconds))
+        leader = Decimal(leader_cost) * Decimal(leader_seconds)
+        report["comparison"] = {"cost_usd": cost, "seconds": seconds, "cost_times_seconds": str(product),
+                                "leader_product": str(leader), "relative_product": str(product / leader),
+                                "under_90_seconds": seconds < 90,
+                                "cost_needed_at_90_seconds": str(leader / Decimal(90))}
+    return report
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("captures", nargs="+", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=float)
+    parser.add_argument("--cost")
+    parser.add_argument("--leader-cost", default="0.02583")
+    parser.add_argument("--leader-seconds", default="38.259")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(analyze(args.captures, seconds=args.seconds, cost=args.cost,
+                             leader_cost=args.leader_cost, leader_seconds=args.leader_seconds), indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

"""Profiling stays causal, counts all metered work, and excludes source values."""
import asyncio
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from rfq import profile

_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "profile_ledger", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "dev" / "profile_ledger.py")
ledger = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(ledger)


@pytest.fixture
def events(monkeypatch):
    captured = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "ENABLED", True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "log", lambda event, **fields: captured.append({"event": event, **fields}))
    return captured


def test_parallel_nested_spans_keep_task_parents_and_cancellation(events):
    async def scenario():
        async def worker():
            async with profile.span("decision", category="decision") as decision:
                async with profile.span("request", category="model") as request:
                    await asyncio.sleep(0)
                assert request.parent == decision.id
        with profile.span("run") as run:
            await asyncio.gather(worker(), worker())
            task = asyncio.create_task(cancelled())
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
            task.cancel()
            with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task
        assert all(event["parent"] == run.id for event in events if event["name"] == "decision")

    async def cancelled():
        async with profile.span("cancelled_request"):
            await asyncio.Event().wait()

    asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert next(event for event in events if event["name"] == "cancelled_request")["status"] == "cancelled"
    assert profile._parent.get() is None
    assert all(event["seconds"] >= 0 for event in events)


def test_disabled_spans_do_not_read_clocks_or_emit(monkeypatch, events):
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "ENABLED", False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile.time, "monotonic_ns", lambda: pytest.fail("disabled profiler read the clock"))
    with profile.span("disabled"):
        pass
    assert events == []


def test_metadata_rejects_source_values_and_prompt_counts_do_not_copy(events):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        profile.span("form", secret="hidden")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        profile.span("form", rows="hidden")
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "synthetic"},
                                               {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "hidden"}}]}]
    assert profile.prompt_metrics(messages) == {"characters": 9, "images": 1}
    assert events == []


def test_metering_counts_cached_input_once_and_speculative_work(events):
    profile.model_usage(attempt_id=10, model="synthetic", input_tokens=1000, output_tokens=20,
                        cached_tokens=800, reasoning_tokens=5)
    profile.model_usage(attempt_id=11, model="synthetic", input_tokens=500, output_tokens=10,
                        cached_tokens=400, reasoning_tokens=7, reasoning_in_output=False, speculative=True)
    profile.model_usage(attempt_id=12, model="synthetic", known=False, speculative=True)
    result = ledger.token_ledger(events + [events[0]])
    assert result["attempts"] == 3
    assert result["total_tokens"] == 1537
    assert result["cached_tokens"] == 1200
    assert result["speculative_tokens"] == 517
    assert result["unknown_usage_attempts"] == 1 and not result["complete"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        profile.model_usage(attempt_id=13, model="synthetic", input_tokens=3, output_tokens=1, cached_tokens=4)


def test_overlapping_spans_are_not_summed_as_wall_time():
    events = [dict(event="profile_span", id=1, name="request", category="model", start=2, seconds=5),
              dict(event="profile_span", id=2, name="request", category="model", start=4, seconds=7)]
    result = ledger.span_ledger(events, wall_seconds=15)
    assert result["categories"]["model"] == {"count": 2, "summed_seconds": 12, "union_seconds": 9}
    assert result["uninstrumented_gaps"] == [[11, 15], [0, 2]]


def test_incomplete_platform_capture_cannot_pass_budget(tmp_path):
    capture = tmp_path / "capture.json"
    capture.write_text('{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Status running\\n'
                       'LLM: 10 calls, $0.01, 90,000 in / 10,000 out tokens\\n'
                       'model: 90,000 in (80,000 cached) / 10,000 out"}]}')
    result = ledger.analyze([capture])
    assert result["observed_token_lower_bound"] == 100_000
    assert result["within_200k"] is None
    assert result["platform_snapshots"][0]["cached_tokens"] == 80_000

## 1. Vergabeportal (Public: `atira-rfq-tender-portal`)

- Login → Cookie-Wall → Suche „Ausschreibungen suchen“ (16 Bekanntmachungen, 6 Seiten, Filter Auftraggeber).
  Aktenzeichen als `role=img` mit Zero-Width-Text; Frist hinter Button „Frist“ (Tooltip, Zeitzone Athen).
- Akte: Menü „Verfahrensakte ▾“ (Hover-Menü) → Übersicht / Unterlagen (`?tab=documents`) / Bieterfragen (`?tab=questions`).
  Brief: Dokumente evtl. erst nach „Teilnahme bekunden“ (Expression of Interest). Im geteilten Scouting-Account war die
  Teilnahme bereits registriert → im echten Run kommt dieser Schritt zuerst!
- Unterlagen: Liste mit Dreifach-„Öffnen“ (Q5), Viewer-iframe, „Sammelakte → Aktionen → Unterlagen als ZIP“
  (Menü auch per Rechtsklick/Shift+F10). Dokumente: LV (CSV: `Position;Kurztext;Menge;Einheit;Anforderung`),
  Leistungsbeschreibung (TXT, verweist auf Lastenheft „maßgeblich ist dessen aktuelle Revision“), Positionsübersicht
  (breite Tabelle). Inhalt jeweils in `<details>`.
- Einheiten: Positionen in `Stk` **und** `Satz` (→ Umrechnung über Spezifikation).
- Bieterfragen: iframe → iframe, Tabelle Nr. | Datum (Tooltip, Athen + UTC-ISO) | Frage (`summary`) + Antwort (`details`).
  **Nicht chronologisch und nicht nach Nummer sortiert** (z. B. Nr. 3916 vom 16.01. schlägt Nr. 8148 vom 12.01.).
  Inhaltstypen in public-1:
  - Mengenänderung („verbindliche Gesamtmenge … Satz/Stück“) — zusätzlich als Canvas „Mengenänderung“.
  - **Zurückziehung** („Die Antwort auf Rückfrage N wird ersatzlos zurückgezogen“) → ignoriere N, nimm vorherige gültige.
  - Technischer Nachtrag („Für <Ref>, Revision R-…, Anforderung A-…: Hub/Stellweg = … mm. Nur dieses Merkmal…“),
    mehrere Nachträge → je Merkmal jüngster. Nachträge zu anderen Revisionen ignorieren.
  - Konditionszuordnung („Für Position … gilt Konditionsgruppe K-…“).
  - Rüstkosten je Position („einmalig … EUR netto, gleichmäßig auf endgültige Stückzahl, nicht rabattieren“).
  - Ausführungs-/Abrechnungszuordnung je Position: Verpackungstarif, Terminschlüssel, Rüstpool, Bonusplan
    („Kein Rüstpool; kein Projektbonus“ explizit möglich).
- „Neue Rückfrage stellen“ — nicht benutzen.

### Konfigurator („Angebotsabgabe“, 10 Schritte, Server-Rendering, `revision`-Hidden-Field)

1. Bieterdaten: Firmenname, USt-IdNr. (aus Brief), Kontakt-E-Mail (nicht im Brief spezifiziert → Bieter-Mailbox aus
   Webmail-Identität „Angemeldet als …“). „Weiter“.
2. Angebotsart: Select mit **vorausgewähltem „Nebenangebot“** → „Hauptangebot“ (bid) bzw. „Verzichtserklärung“ (no_bid).
3.–7. **Eine Position pro Schritt, in zufälliger Reihenfolge** (Überschrift „Position 01.04“). Kaskade:
   Bohrung → „Auswahl übernehmen“ → Hub → übernehmen → Befestigung → übernehmen → Zertifizierung (`none` =
   „Ohne Zertifizierung“) → übernehmen → Katalognummer (zeigt nur passende, z. B. `HZ-… · 210 bar`).
   Dann Menge (Stk), Einzelpreis netto (deutsches Format), `<details>` „Preisaufbau“: Basispreis je Stück vor Rabatt,
   Zuschläge je Stück, Verpackung je Stück, Projektbonus für gesamte Position; Lieferzeit (Select 1–52 Wochen).
   Buttons: „Position auslassen (Teilpunkte)“, **„Position hinzufügen“ (erzeugt Extra-Position → Punktabzug!)**,
   „Weiter“, „Zurück“ (verwirft spätere Schritte).
   Hinweistext im Formular: „Zuschläge = Materialzuschlag + anteilige Rüstkosten, auf Cent gerundet. Endpreis
   separat aus ungerundeten Bestandteilen berechnen.“ „Auch anteilige Rüstpoolkosten gehören zu den Zuschlägen.“
8. Konditionen: Rabatt (%), Nettosumme (EUR). Angezeigt: Bruttosumme inkl. 19 % USt (en-US-Format!) und versteckter
   Köder `total_net=…` → beides ignorieren, eigene Nettosumme eintragen.
9. Erklärungen: ☐ „Vergabeunterlagen anerkannt“ (**anhaken**), ☐ „Es gelten unsere AGB“ (**nicht anhaken**).
10. Prüfen und signieren: Zusammenfassung (Bieter, Aktenzeichen, Angebotsart, Rabatt, Nettosumme, Tabelle,
    „Ausgelassene Positionen: …“) → „TAN anfordern“ → Feld „Signatur-TAN“ → „Angebot verbindlich abgeben“
    (Submit-Handler ruft `window.confirm('Angebot verbindlich abgeben? Diese Abgabe beendet den Lauf.')` →
    **Playwright verwirft Dialoge standardmäßig! → `page.once("dialog", lambda d: d.accept())` vor dem Klick.**)

## 2. Lieferantenportal (Public: `atira-rfq-customer-portal`)

- Login-Seite hat schon Fake-Browserleiste + Hinweis. Cookie-Wall. Startseite: Dreifach-„Dokumentenübersicht“ (Q5).
- Dokumentenregister: **1 Eintrag pro Seite** (4 Seiten), Spalten Dokumentnummer | Titel (mit „Aktionen“-Menü →
  „Dokument anzeigen“) | Zuordnung (Referenz als `role=img`) | Typ. Lastenheft = „Technische Spezifikation“.
- Lastenheft-Seite: erst **Dokumentenüberlassung**: Radio (Archivkopie / Verbindliche Unterlagen zur Kenntnis
  genommen ✔ / Nur Vorschau), Belegnummer aus Canvas übertragen, ☑ „Überlassungsbedingungen gelesen“,
  „Leseberechtigung anfordern“ (nicht „Abbrechen und Eingaben löschen“).
- Danach: Revisionshistorie in `<details>`: Revision | Datum (TT/MM bzw. MM/TT gemischt!) | Status nur im Tooltip

- Viewer: 1 Anforderung pro Seite (5 Seiten) mit „Nächste Seite“/„Weitere laden“. Spalten: Referenz | Anforderung

  Originalwortlaut enthält: **Kataloggruppe** (für ERP-Suche), ggf. „Maßbezug: Hub/Stellweg ist nutzbarer Weg.
  ERP-Nennweg = nutzbarer Weg + 2 × Endreserve. Endreserve-Schlüssel ER-…; revisionsgebundene Technikfreigabe
  beachten“, ggf. „Lieferumfang: 1 Satz = N Stück“.
- Überschrift „Druckvorschau: Spaltenbreiten…“ ist Rauschen.

## 3. ERP (Public: `atira-rfq-erp`, „SAP GUI für HTML“, Zeitangaben UTC, Systemdatum = Szenariodatum)

- Login → Cookie-Wall → (gelegentlich) „Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar“ → **Systemmitteilung-Gate** (Slider +
  „kein Roboter“ + Empfangsnummer aus Canvas + „Betriebsbedingungen gelesen“ → „Weiter“).

- Login → (Cookie) → Postfach mit Fake-Browserleiste, Hinweis-Dialog (unten). Ordner-Menü: Posteingang, **Archiv**.
  Identität „Angemeldet als vertrieb@<bieter-domain>“ → **Bieter-Mailbox-Domain** für autorisierte Absender.
- Suche: „mehrere Suchwörter UND-verknüpft. Vergabereferenz mit Betreff/Stichwort kombinieren, Lieferzusagen
  zusätzlich mit Artikelnummer. Maximal 20 Treffer. Neue Signatur-TANs erscheinen auch ohne Suche.“

  `Rabattfreigabe · leitung` (auch bedingt: „sofern unrabattierter Nettoauftragswert mindestens X EUR“; ältere

  - Technischer Nachtrag („Für <Ref>, Revision R-…, Anforderung A-…: Hub/Stellweg = … mm. Nur dieses Merkmal…“),
    mehrere Nachträge → je Merkmal jüngster. Nachträge zu anderen Revisionen ignorieren.
  - Konditionszuordnung („Für Position … gilt Konditionsgruppe K-…“).
  - Rüstkosten je Position („einmalig … EUR netto, gleichmäßig auf endgültige Stückzahl, nicht rabattieren“).
  - Ausführungs-/Abrechnungszuordnung je Position: Verpackungstarif, Terminschlüssel, Rüstpool, Bonusplan
    („Kein Rüstpool; kein Projektbonus“ explizit möglich).
- „Neue Rückfrage stellen“ — nicht benutzen.

### Konfigurator („Angebotsabgabe“, 10 Schritte, Server-Rendering, `revision`-Hidden-Field)

1. Bieterdaten: Firmenname, USt-IdNr. (aus Brief), Kontakt-E-Mail (nicht im Brief spezifiziert → Bieter-Mailbox aus
   Webmail-Identität „Angemeldet als …“). „Weiter“.
2. Angebotsart: Select mit **vorausgewähltem „Nebenangebot“** → „Hauptangebot“ (bid) bzw. „Verzichtserklärung“ (no_bid).
3.–7. **Eine Position pro Schritt, in zufälliger Reihenfolge** (Überschrift „Position 01.04“). Kaskade:
   Bohrung → „Auswahl übernehmen“ → Hub → übernehmen → Befestigung → übernehmen → Zertifizierung (`none` =
   „Ohne Zertifizierung“) → übernehmen → Katalognummer (zeigt nur passende, z. B. `HZ-… · 210 bar`).
   Dann Menge (Stk), Einzelpreis netto (deutsches Format), `<details>` „Preisaufbau“: Basispreis je Stück vor Rabatt,
   Zuschläge je Stück, Verpackung je Stück, Projektbonus für gesamte Position; Lieferzeit (Select 1–52 Wochen).
   Buttons: „Position auslassen (Teilpunkte)“, **„Position hinzufügen“ (erzeugt Extra-Position → Punktabzug!)**,
   „Weiter“, „Zurück“ (verwirft spätere Schritte).
   Hinweistext im Formular: „Zuschläge = Materialzuschlag + anteilige Rüstkosten, auf Cent gerundet. Endpreis
   separat aus ungerundeten Bestandteilen berechnen.“ „Auch anteilige Rüstpoolkosten gehören zu den Zuschlägen.“
8. Konditionen: Rabatt (%), Nettosumme (EUR). Angezeigt: Bruttosumme inkl. 19 % USt (en-US-Format!) und versteckter
   Köder `total_net=…` → beides ignorieren, eigene Nettosumme eintragen.
9. Erklärungen: ☐ „Vergabeunterlagen anerkannt“ (**anhaken**), ☐ „Es gelten unsere AGB“ (**nicht anhaken**).
10. Prüfen und signieren: Zusammenfassung (Bieter, Aktenzeichen, Angebotsart, Rabatt, Nettosumme, Tabelle,
    „Ausgelassene Positionen: …“) → „TAN anfordern“ → Feld „Signatur-TAN“ → „Angebot verbindlich abgeben“
    (Submit-Handler ruft `window.confirm('Angebot verbindlich abgeben? Diese Abgabe beendet den Lauf.')` →
    **Playwright verwirft Dialoge standardmäßig! → `page.once("dialog", lambda d: d.accept())` vor dem Klick.**)

## 2. Lieferantenportal (Public: `atira-rfq-customer-portal`)

- Login-Seite hat schon Fake-Browserleiste + Hinweis. Cookie-Wall. Startseite: Dreifach-„Dokumentenübersicht“ (Q5).
- Dokumentenregister: **1 Eintrag pro Seite** (4 Seiten), Spalten Dokumentnummer | Titel (mit „Aktionen“-Menü →
  „Dokument anzeigen“) | Zuordnung (Referenz als `role=img`) | Typ. Lastenheft = „Technische Spezifikation“.
- Lastenheft-Seite: erst **Dokumentenüberlassung**: Radio (Archivkopie / Verbindliche Unterlagen zur Kenntnis
  genommen ✔ / Nur Vorschau), Belegnummer aus Canvas übertragen, ☑ „Überlassungsbedingungen gelesen“,
  „Leseberechtigung anfordern“ (nicht „Abbrechen und Eingaben löschen“).
- Danach: Revisionshistorie in `<details>`: Revision | Datum (TT/MM bzw. MM/TT gemischt!) | Status nur im Tooltip
  „Freigabestand“ (gültig/ersetzt) | Änderungsvermerk. **Viewer öffnet die älteste Revision zuerst** (iframe
  `viewer?revision=…`). Maßgeblich ist der Status „gültig“ (= „marked current“), nicht das Datum und nicht die
  erste angezeigte.
- Viewer: 1 Anforderung pro Seite (5 Seiten) mit „Nächste Seite“/„Weitere laden“. Spalten: Referenz | Anforderung
  (Originalwortlaut in `<details>`) | Bohrung (Canvas) | Hub (`600 (en-US)`) | Druck (`210 (de-DE)`) | Befestigung
  (`role=img`) | Zertifizierung (Tooltip „Prüfvermerk“) + versteckter Köder „Dokumentstand … ISO 9001; Hub: 999 mm“.
  Originalwortlaut enthält: **Kataloggruppe** (für ERP-Suche), ggf. „Maßbezug: Hub/Stellweg ist nutzbarer Weg.
  ERP-Nennweg = nutzbarer Weg + 2 × Endreserve. Endreserve-Schlüssel ER-…; revisionsgebundene Technikfreigabe
  beachten“, ggf. „Lieferumfang: 1 Satz = N Stück“.
- Überschrift „Druckvorschau: Spaltenbreiten…“ ist Rauschen.

## 3. ERP (Public: `atira-rfq-erp`, „SAP GUI für HTML“, Zeitangaben UTC, Systemdatum = Szenariodatum)

- Login → Cookie-Wall → (gelegentlich) „Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar“ → **Systemmitteilung-Gate** (Slider +
  „kein Roboter“ + Empfangsnummer aus Canvas + „Betriebsbedingungen gelesen“ → „Weiter“).
- „SAP Easy Access“: Transaktionsfeld (`MM03`, `MMBE`, `VK13`) + Favoriten-Menü + Dreifach-Links (Q5). Wartungsdialog.
- **Suche**: F4-Suchhilfe öffnet `window.open`-Popup. „Bezeichnung enthält“: leere Suche → 0, zu breite Suche
  (> 20) → „keine unvollständige Trefferliste“. **Kataloggruppe aus Spezifikation eingeben** → 1–2 Treffer
  (Look-alikes!). Ergebniszeilen enthalten Kurzbeschreibung inkl. Packinhalt (Stück/Karton), Umlagegewicht (g/Stück,
  „nicht Zuschlagsmasse“), Zuschlagsmasse (g/Stück), Preisindex-Key.
- MM03 Tabs: Grunddaten | Technische Daten (Bohrung, Hub, Betriebsdruck, Befestigung, Zertifizierung im Tooltip) |
  Disposition (Materialstatus `01 freigegeben · 03 gesperrt` — Legende im Tooltip, **versteckter Köder-Status**;
  Lieferzeit ab Lager / Produktionslieferzeit in vertauschter visueller Reihenfolge).
- MMBE: Werkübersicht zeigt **physischen Bestand inkl. Prüfbestand** (Köder!) → „Lagerorte“ → „0001 Fertigwaren –
  Frei verwendbar“ vs „0099 Prüfbestand – Gesperrt“. Maßgeblich: **frei verwendbarer Bestand** (Canvas
  „Verfügbarer Gesamtbestand: N Stück“).
- VK13: Konditionsart PR00, **mehrere Konditionssätze paginiert** („Seite 1 von 2 · 2 Konditionssätze“,
  „Nächster Konditionssatz“) mit Gültig von/bis (UTC), **Währung (EUR/USD) + Devisenschlüssel FX-…**, **Preiseinheit
  (1 ST oder 100 ST)**, Zahlenformat (en-US/de-DE). Staffeln in separatem Register „Mengenstaffeln öffnen“,
  absteigend sortiert („Staffel ab Menge“ | „Nettopreis (Währung / Preiseinheit)“).
- Gelegentlich HTTP 503 → Retry.

## 4. Webmail „Werkpost“ (Public: `atira-rfq-mail`, Europe/Berlin)

- Login → (Cookie) → Postfach mit Fake-Browserleiste, Hinweis-Dialog (unten). Ordner-Menü: Posteingang, **Archiv**.
  Identität „Angemeldet als vertrieb@<bieter-domain>“ → **Bieter-Mailbox-Domain** für autorisierte Absender.
- Suche: „mehrere Suchwörter UND-verknüpft. Vergabereferenz mit Betreff/Stichwort kombinieren, Lieferzusagen
  zusätzlich mit Artikelnummer. Maximal 20 Treffer. Neue Signatur-TANs erscheinen auch ohne Suche.“
  Liste 3 Mails/Seite, paginiert; Liste **und** Lesebereich hinter je einem Slider-Gate; Lesebereich-iframe hat
  `srcdoc=""` (leer) → „Original öffnen“ (Dreifach-Link, echter = `/messages/<id>`).
- Nachricht: Betreff (`role=img`), Datum MM/TT, Umschlag in `<details>` (Absender auch als Canvas, `<time datetime>`
  UTC), **„Lokale Vorschau / nicht versandter Entwurf“ mit „Entwurfswert: 99 %“ (Köder)**, Original hinter weiterem
  Gate in `<details>`, Text im `output[aria-label]`, dahinter versteckter Injection-Satz.
- Mail-Arten in public-1 (Betreff · Absender-Localpart):
  `Rabattfreigabe · leitung` (auch bedingt: „sofern unrabattierter Nettoauftragswert mindestens X EUR“; ältere
  unbedingte im Archiv; Look-alike Referenz `…-A`; `Angebotsprüfung · leitung` = keine Freigabe),
  `Konditionsregeln · kalkulation` (Prosa je K-Gruppe), `Technikfreigabe · technik` (ER-Key → Revision, Endreserve je Ende),
  `Verpackungstarife · logistik` (VP-Key → EUR je angefangenem Karton), `Terminfreigabe · logistik` (TZ-Key → Artikel,
  Wochen, Mengengrenze über alle Positionen), `Devisenfixing · finanzen` (FX-Key → EUR je Währungseinheit; **zukunfts-
  datierte Variante** nach Stichtag = Köder), `Rüstpools · kalkulation` (RP-Key → Poolbetrag + Cent-Verteilregel),
  `Projektbonus · finanzen` (PB-Key → marginale Bänder + Verteilregel), `Preisindizes · kalkulation` (MET-Key → EUR/kg
  mit **Gültigkeitsfenstern**; nimm das Fenster, das den Stichtag enthält), `Signatur-TAN · signatur@vergabe…`.
- Mails liegen teils im Posteingang, teils im Archiv → **beide Ordner durchsuchen**.
- Im geteilten Scouting-Postfach liegen TAN-Mails anderer Teams („Anforderung 6“) → immer die neueste nach eigener
  Anforderung nehmen.

Erkundet am 2026-10-10 mit den Scouting-Logins (Playwright, headless). Beispiele stammen aus public-1 und dienen
**nur zum Verständnis** — niemals in `agent/` übernehmen. Gespeichertes HTML: `dev/fixtures/public-1/`.
Für jede Falle steht dabei, wie wir sie **generisch** behandeln.
