## 1. Vergabeportal (Public: `atira-rfq-tender-portal`)

- Login → Cookie-Wall → Suche „Ausschreibungen suchen“ (16 Bekanntmachungen, 6 Seiten, Filter Auftraggeber).
  Aktenzeichen als `role=img` mit Zero-Width-Text; Frist hinter Button „Frist“ (Tooltip, Zeitzone Athen).
- Akte: Menü „Verfahrensakte ▾“ (Hover-Menü) → Übersicht / Unterlagen (`?tab=documents`) / Bieterfragen (`?tab=questions`).
  Brief: Dokumente evtl. erst nach „Teilnahme bekunden“ (Expression of Interest). Im geteilten Scouting-Account war die
  Teilnahme bereits registriert → im echten Run kommt dieser Schritt zuerst!
- Unterlagen: Liste mit Dreifach-„Öffnen“ (Q5), Viewer-iframe, „Sammelakte → Aktionen → Unterlagen als ZIP“
  (Menü auch per Rechtsklick/Shift+F10). Dokumente: LV (CSV: `Position;Kurztext;Menge;Einheit;Anforderung`),
  Leistungsbeschreibung (TXT, verweist auf Lastenheft „maßgeblich ist dessen aktuelle Revision“), Positionsübersicht
  (breite Tabelle). Inhalt jeweils in `<details>`.
- Einheiten: Positionen in `Stk` **und** `Satz` (→ Umrechnung über Spezifikation).
- Bieterfragen: iframe → iframe, Tabelle Nr. | Datum (Tooltip, Athen + UTC-ISO) | Frage (`summary`) + Antwort (`details`).
  **Nicht chronologisch und nicht nach Nummer sortiert** (z. B. Nr. 3916 vom 16.01. schlägt Nr. 8148 vom 12.01.).
  Inhaltstypen in public-1:
  - Mengenänderung („verbindliche Gesamtmenge … Satz/Stück“) — zusätzlich als Canvas „Mengenänderung“.
  - **Zurückziehung** („Die Antwort auf Rückfrage N wird ersatzlos zurückgezogen“) → ignoriere N, nimm vorherige gültige.
  - Technischer Nachtrag („Für <Ref>, Revision R-…, Anforderung A-…: Hub/Stellweg = … mm. Nur dieses Merkmal…“),
    mehrere Nachträge → je Merkmal jüngster. Nachträge zu anderen Revisionen ignorieren.
  - Konditionszuordnung („Für Position … gilt Konditionsgruppe K-…“).
  - Rüstkosten je Position („einmalig … EUR netto, gleichmäßig auf endgültige Stückzahl, nicht rabattieren“).
  - Ausführungs-/Abrechnungszuordnung je Position: Verpackungstarif, Terminschlüssel, Rüstpool, Bonusplan
    („Kein Rüstpool; kein Projektbonus“ explizit möglich).
- „Neue Rückfrage stellen“ — nicht benutzen.

### Konfigurator („Angebotsabgabe“, 10 Schritte, Server-Rendering, `revision`-Hidden-Field)

1. Bieterdaten: Firmenname, USt-IdNr. (aus Brief), Kontakt-E-Mail (nicht im Brief spezifiziert → Bieter-Mailbox aus
   Webmail-Identität „Angemeldet als …“). „Weiter“.
2. Angebotsart: Select mit **vorausgewähltem „Nebenangebot“** → „Hauptangebot“ (bid) bzw. „Verzichtserklärung“ (no_bid).
3.–7. **Eine Position pro Schritt, in zufälliger Reihenfolge** (Überschrift „Position 01.04“). Kaskade:
   Bohrung → „Auswahl übernehmen“ → Hub → übernehmen → Befestigung → übernehmen → Zertifizierung (`none` =
   „Ohne Zertifizierung“) → übernehmen → Katalognummer (zeigt nur passende, z. B. `HZ-… · 210 bar`).
   Dann Menge (Stk), Einzelpreis netto (deutsches Format), `<details>` „Preisaufbau“: Basispreis je Stück vor Rabatt,
   Zuschläge je Stück, Verpackung je Stück, Projektbonus für gesamte Position; Lieferzeit (Select 1–52 Wochen).
   Buttons: „Position auslassen (Teilpunkte)“, **„Position hinzufügen“ (erzeugt Extra-Position → Punktabzug!)**,
   „Weiter“, „Zurück“ (verwirft spätere Schritte).
   Hinweistext im Formular: „Zuschläge = Materialzuschlag + anteilige Rüstkosten, auf Cent gerundet. Endpreis
   separat aus ungerundeten Bestandteilen berechnen.“ „Auch anteilige Rüstpoolkosten gehören zu den Zuschlägen.“
8. Konditionen: Rabatt (%), Nettosumme (EUR). Angezeigt: Bruttosumme inkl. 19 % USt (en-US-Format!) und versteckter
   Köder `total_net=…` → beides ignorieren, eigene Nettosumme eintragen.
9. Erklärungen: ☐ „Vergabeunterlagen anerkannt“ (**anhaken**), ☐ „Es gelten unsere AGB“ (**nicht anhaken**).
10. Prüfen und signieren: Zusammenfassung (Bieter, Aktenzeichen, Angebotsart, Rabatt, Nettosumme, Tabelle,
    „Ausgelassene Positionen: …“) → „TAN anfordern“ → Feld „Signatur-TAN“ → „Angebot verbindlich abgeben“
    (Submit-Handler ruft `window.confirm('Angebot verbindlich abgeben? Diese Abgabe beendet den Lauf.')` →
    **Playwright verwirft Dialoge standardmäßig! → `page.once("dialog", lambda d: d.accept())` vor dem Klick.**)

## 2. Lieferantenportal (Public: `atira-rfq-customer-portal`)

- Login-Seite hat schon Fake-Browserleiste + Hinweis. Cookie-Wall. Startseite: Dreifach-„Dokumentenübersicht“ (Q5).
- Dokumentenregister: **1 Eintrag pro Seite** (4 Seiten), Spalten Dokumentnummer | Titel (mit „Aktionen“-Menü →
  „Dokument anzeigen“) | Zuordnung (Referenz als `role=img`) | Typ. Lastenheft = „Technische Spezifikation“.
- Lastenheft-Seite: erst **Dokumentenüberlassung**: Radio (Archivkopie / Verbindliche Unterlagen zur Kenntnis
  genommen ✔ / Nur Vorschau), Belegnummer aus Canvas übertragen, ☑ „Überlassungsbedingungen gelesen“,
  „Leseberechtigung anfordern“ (nicht „Abbrechen und Eingaben löschen“).
- Danach: Revisionshistorie in `<details>`: Revision | Datum (TT/MM bzw. MM/TT gemischt!) | Status nur im Tooltip

  `viewer?revision=…`). Maßgeblich ist der Status „gültig“ (= „marked current“), nicht das Datum und nicht die
  erste angezeigte.
- Viewer: 1 Anforderung pro Seite (5 Seiten) mit „Nächste Seite“/„Weitere laden“. Spalten: Referenz | Anforderung

  Originalwortlaut enthält: **Kataloggruppe** (für ERP-Suche), ggf. „Maßbezug: Hub/Stellweg ist nutzbarer Weg.
  ERP-Nennweg = nutzbarer Weg + 2 × Endreserve. Endreserve-Schlüssel ER-…; revisionsgebundene Technikfreigabe

## 3. ERP (Public: `atira-rfq-erp`, „SAP GUI für HTML“, Zeitangaben UTC, Systemdatum = Szenariodatum)

"""Eligibility and master-record merging shared by collection and resolution."""
from . import parse


def mail_problem(message, reference, cutoff, local='', domain=None):
    if parse.norm_id(message.get('reference')) != parse.norm_id(reference):
        return 'other reference'
    if message.get('is_draft_or_preview'):
        return 'draft/preview'
    at = parse.when(message.get('datetime_utc'))
    if at is None or (cutoff is not None and at > cutoff):
        return 'after the scenario date' if at else 'no readable date'
    sender = parse.mail_address(message.get('sender'))
    if (local and not sender.startswith(local.lower() + '@')) or (domain and not sender.endswith('@' + domain.lower())):
        return 'not from the authorized sender'
    return None


def merge_materials(items):
    merged = {}
    for item in items:
        for material in item['data'].get('materials') or []:
            num = parse.norm_id(material.get('material_number'))
            if not num:
                continue
            target = merged.setdefault(num, {'material_number': parse.clean(material['material_number']), 'conditions': []})
            for key, value in material.items():
                if key == 'conditions':
                    for condition in value or []:
                        if condition.get('scales') and condition not in target['conditions']:
                            target['conditions'].append(condition)
                elif key in ('status_code', 'status_meaning', 'status_scope'):
                    continue
                elif value not in (None, '', []):
                    target[key] = value
            status = material.get('status_meaning')
            scope = material.get('status_scope', 'material')
            if status and scope == 'material':
                statuses = target.setdefault('_statuses', {})
                statuses[status] = {'code': material.get('status_code'), 'url': item.get('url', '')}
                if len(statuses) == 1:
                    target['status_meaning'] = status
                    target['status_code'] = material.get('status_code')
                else:
                    # A stock/inspection status must never overwrite master status.
                    # Conflicting master records require a focused source recheck.
                    target['status_meaning'] = None
                    target['_status_conflict'] = dict(statuses)
            if material.get('status_verified') is True and status and scope == 'material':
                target['status_meaning'] = status

import asyncio
import json
import time

from .. import llm
from ..log import log
from ..profile import span
from .explorer import ACTIONS, OUTSIDE_STATE, Explorer, _hints, _links
from .prompts import EXTRACT_SYSTEM, FUSED_SYSTEM, KINDS
from .records import ActionResult, Decision, Observation


def field_guide(kind):
    """The original fact contract with repeated prose/whitespace removed."""
    return ' '.join(KINDS[kind]['schema'].split())


class FusedExplorer(Explorer):
    snapshot: Observation | None = None

    async def _loop(self, tools, tag):
        if hasattr(self.site, 'wait_started'):
            await self.site.wait_started()
        allowed = {t['function']['name'] for t in tools} | {'read_region', 'bind_fields'}
        operation_guide = '\n'.join(
            t['function']['name'] + '(' + ','.join(t['function']['parameters'].get('properties', {})) + ')'
            for t in tools)
        operation_guide += '\nread_region(region); bind_fields(fields:[{ref,path,format?,apply?}],then_click?)'
        intro = (f'MISSION {self.mission.name} on {self.site.site_id}: {self.mission.goal}\n'
                 f'CONTEXT: {self.mission.context}\nOPERATIONS:\n{operation_guide}')
        orch = getattr(self.extractor, '__self__', None)
        repeats = {}
        premature_finish = False
        self.source_cache = {}
        for step in range(self.mission.max_steps):
            if self.mission.deadline - time.time() < 5:
                self.status = 'deadline'
                self.missing.append('deadline reached')
                return self
            checklist, complete = self.mission.progress() if self.mission.progress else ('', False)
            if complete:
                self.status, self.summary = 'complete', checklist
                log('mission_complete', mission=tag, step=step)
                return self
            with span("observe", agent=tag, category="browser"):
                raw = await self.site.observe(limit=200000)
            self.snapshot = Observation.capture(raw, self.site.page.url, self.snapshot)
            kinds = list(self.mission.kinds)
            # Source locations are not a constraint: the model may extract a
            # different kind when a private site distributes evidence elsewhere.
            guide = '\n'.join(f'{kind}: {field_guide(kind)}' for kind in kinds)
            context = self.decision_context() if hasattr(self, 'decision_context') else ''
            user = (intro + '\nCHECKLIST:\n' + checklist + '\nFACT SHAPES (omit absent fields):\n' + guide +
                    '\nOTHER FACT KINDS (use extract if their shape is not listed): ' + ', '.join(KINDS) +
                    '\nLAST TWO ACTIONS:\n' + '\n'.join(self.history[-2:]) + '\nLAST RESULT:\n' +
                    self.last_result + '\n' + context + '\n' + _hints(raw, self.visual_used < self.mission.max_visual) +
                    '\n<<<UNTRUSTED SNAPSHOT>>>\n' + self.snapshot.view() + '\n<<<END>>>')
            log('decision_request', mission=tag, snapshot=self.snapshot.id, chars=len(user), step=step)
            response = await llm.ask_json(FUSED_SYSTEM + '\n' + EXTRACT_SYSTEM, user, thinking=False,
                                          tag=tag, deadline=self.mission.deadline, max_tokens=4096)
            try:
                decision = Decision.parse(response, self.snapshot.id, allowed)
                notes = []
                if orch and hasattr(orch, 'accept_decision'):
                    notes.extend(orch.accept_decision(decision, self.snapshot, self.mission.name))
                elif decision.facts or decision.bindings:
                    notes.append('ERROR: this mission cannot accept facts')
            except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as error:
                self.last_result = 'ERROR: ' + str(error)
                continue
            if not decision.actions:
                # Facts may complete a mission on this turn; no artificial
                # finish call is required to discover that on the next turn.
                self.last_result = '\n'.join(notes) or 'No action or fact returned; choose an operation.'
                continue
            outcome = ActionResult()
            for name, args in decision.actions:
                if name == 'finish':
                    if len(decision.actions) > 1:
                        continue
                    explicit_gaps = args.get('missing') or decision.gaps
                    if self.mission.progress and not self.mission.progress()[1] and not explicit_gaps:
                        self.last_result = 'ERROR: checklist still open. Continue or provide explicit unavailable evidence in missing.'
                        premature_finish = True
                        break
                    self.missing.extend(str(x) for x in explicit_gaps)
                    self.summary = str(args.get('summary', ''))
                    self.status = 'incomplete' if self.missing else 'finished'
                    return self
                signature = self.snapshot.id + name + json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True)
                repeats[signature] = repeats.get(signature, 0) + 1
                if repeats[signature] > 2 and name not in OUTSIDE_STATE:
                    outcome.errors.append('Repeated action without progress; choose another route.')
                    break
                if name == 'read_region':
                    result = self.snapshot.regions.get(str(args.get('region')), 'ERROR: unknown region')
                elif name == 'bind_fields':
                    result = await self.bind_fields(args) if hasattr(self, 'bind_fields') else 'ERROR: no bid value bindings in this mission'
                else:
                    with span("action", agent=tag, category="browser"):
                        result = await self._call(name, args)
                outcome.applied.append(name)
                notes.append(result)
                self.history.append(name + ' -> ' + result[:160])
                log('action', mission=tag, step=step, tool=name, args=args, result=result[:300])
                if self.stop:
                    return self
                if result.startswith('ERROR') or 'STOPPED' in result:
                    outcome.errors.append(result)
                    break
                # Every interaction can rerender a different frame/control while
                # keeping the URL. Do not apply stale bindings to that new state.
                if name in ACTIONS or name == 'bind_fields':
                    after = Observation.capture(await self.site.observe(limit=200000), self.site.page.url)
                    outcome.next_snapshot = after.id
                    if after.id != self.snapshot.id:
                        break
            if not premature_finish:
                self.last_result = '\n'.join(notes + outcome.errors)
            premature_finish = False
        self.status = 'incomplete'
        self.missing.append('step budget exhausted')
        return self

    async def _extract_urls(self, args):
        kind = args.get('kind') or (next(iter(self.mission.kinds)) if len(self.mission.kinds) == 1 else None)
        if kind not in KINDS:
            return 'ERROR: select a fact kind before opening sources'
        selected = list(dict.fromkeys(self.site.absolute(str(u)) for u in args.get('urls') or []))[:12]
        gate = asyncio.Semaphore(4)
        async def fetch(url):
            if not self.site.was_seen(url):
                return url, 'ERROR: URL was not observed'
            key = (kind, url, getattr(self.site, 'session_generation', 0))
            if key in self.source_cache:
                return url, self.source_cache[key]
            async with gate:
                return url, await self.site.read_url(url)
        fetched = await asyncio.gather(*(fetch(url) for url in selected))
        items = [(url, text) for url, text in fetched if not text.startswith('ERROR')]
        orch = getattr(self.extractor, '__self__', None)
        if orch and hasattr(orch, 'extract_many'):
            summaries = await orch.extract_many(kind, items, via='page') if items else []
        else:
            summaries = await asyncio.gather(*(self.extractor(kind, text, url, via='page') for url, text in items))
        blocks = [url + ': ' + text for url, text in fetched if text.startswith('ERROR')]
        for (url, text), summary in zip(items, summaries):
            if not summary.startswith('extraction returned nothing'):
                self.source_cache[(kind, url, getattr(self.site, 'session_generation', 0))] = text
            # All offered links are returned. No hidden "offered" set suppresses
            # records that exceeded a previous prompt's character limit.
            links = _links([(url, text)])
            blocks.append(url + ': ' + summary + ('\nSOURCE LINKS:\n' + '\n'.join(label + ' -> ' + link for label, link in links) if links else ''))
        return '\n'.join(blocks)

def merge_materials(items):
    merged = {}
    for item in items:

    return merged

def field_guide(kind):

class FusedExplorer(Explorer):
    snapshot: Observation | None = None

    async def _loop(self, tools, tag):
        if hasattr(self.site, 'wait_started'):
            await self.site.wait_started()
        allowed = {t['function']['name'] for t in tools} | {'read_region', 'bind_fields'}
        operation_guide = '\n'.join(
            t['function']['name'] + '(' + ','.join(t['function']['parameters'].get('properties', {})) + ')'
            for t in tools)
        operation_guide += '\nread_region(region); bind_fields(fields:[{ref,path,format?,apply?}],then_click?)'
        intro = (f'MISSION {self.mission.name} on {self.site.site_id}: {self.mission.goal}\n'
                 f'CONTEXT: {self.mission.context}\nOPERATIONS:\n{operation_guide}')
        orch = getattr(self.extractor, '__self__', None)
        repeats = {}
        premature_finish = False
        self.source_cache = {}
        for step in range(self.mission.max_steps):
            if self.mission.deadline - time.time() < 5:
                self.status = 'deadline'
                self.missing.append('deadline reached')
                return self
            checklist, complete = self.mission.progress() if self.mission.progress else ('', False)
            if complete:
                self.status, self.summary = 'complete', checklist
                log('mission_complete', mission=tag, step=step)
                return self
            with span("observe", agent=tag, category="browser"):
                raw = await self.site.observe(limit=200000)
            self.snapshot = Observation.capture(raw, self.site.page.url, self.snapshot)
            kinds = list(self.mission.kinds)
            # Source locations are not a constraint: the model may extract a
            # different kind when a private site distributes evidence elsewhere.
            guide = '\n'.join(f'{kind}: {field_guide(kind)}' for kind in kinds)
            context = self.decision_context() if hasattr(self, 'decision_context') else ''
            user = (intro + '\nCHECKLIST:\n' + checklist + '\nFACT SHAPES (omit absent fields):\n' + guide +
                    '\nOTHER FACT KINDS (use extract if their shape is not listed): ' + ', '.join(KINDS) +
                    '\nLAST TWO ACTIONS:\n' + '\n'.join(self.history[-2:]) + '\nLAST RESULT:\n' +
                    self.last_result + '\n' + context + '\n' + _hints(raw, self.visual_used < self.mission.max_visual) +
                    '\n<<<UNTRUSTED SNAPSHOT>>>\n' + self.snapshot.view() + '\n<<<END>>>')
            log('decision_request', mission=tag, snapshot=self.snapshot.id, chars=len(user), step=step)
            response = await llm.ask_json(FUSED_SYSTEM + '\n' + EXTRACT_SYSTEM, user, thinking=False,
                                          tag=tag, deadline=self.mission.deadline, max_tokens=4096)
            try:
                decision = Decision.parse(response, self.snapshot.id, allowed)
                notes = []
                if orch and hasattr(orch, 'accept_decision'):
                    notes.extend(orch.accept_decision(decision, self.snapshot, self.mission.name))
                elif decision.facts or decision.bindings:
                    notes.append('ERROR: this mission cannot accept facts')
            except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as error:
                self.last_result = 'ERROR: ' + str(error)
                continue
            if not decision.actions:
                # Facts may complete a mission on this turn; no artificial
                # finish call is required to discover that on the next turn.
                self.last_result = '\n'.join(notes) or 'No action or fact returned; choose an operation.'
                continue
            outcome = ActionResult()
            for name, args in decision.actions:
                if name == 'finish':
                    if len(decision.actions) > 1:
                        continue
                    explicit_gaps = args.get('missing') or decision.gaps
                    if self.mission.progress and not self.mission.progress()[1] and not explicit_gaps:
                        self.last_result = 'ERROR: checklist still open. Continue or provide explicit unavailable evidence in missing.'
                        premature_finish = True
                        break
                    self.missing.extend(str(x) for x in explicit_gaps)
                    self.summary = str(args.get('summary', ''))
                    self.status = 'incomplete' if self.missing else 'finished'
                    return self
                signature = self.snapshot.id + name + json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True)
                repeats[signature] = repeats.get(signature, 0) + 1
                if repeats[signature] > 2 and name not in OUTSIDE_STATE:
                    outcome.errors.append('Repeated action without progress; choose another route.')
                    break
                if name == 'read_region':
                    result = self.snapshot.regions.get(str(args.get('region')), 'ERROR: unknown region')
                elif name == 'bind_fields':
                    result = await self.bind_fields(args) if hasattr(self, 'bind_fields') else 'ERROR: no bid value bindings in this mission'
                else:
                    with span("action", agent=tag, category="browser"):
                        result = await self._call(name, args)
                outcome.applied.append(name)
                notes.append(result)
                self.history.append(name + ' -> ' + result[:160])
                log('action', mission=tag, step=step, tool=name, args=args, result=result[:300])
                if self.stop:
                    return self
                if result.startswith('ERROR') or 'STOPPED' in result:
                    outcome.errors.append(result)
                    break
                # Every interaction can rerender a different frame/control while
                # keeping the URL. Do not apply stale bindings to that new state.
                if name in ACTIONS or name == 'bind_fields':
                    after = Observation.capture(await self.site.observe(limit=200000), self.site.page.url)
                    outcome.next_snapshot = after.id
                    if after.id != self.snapshot.id:
                        break
            if not premature_finish:
                self.last_result = '\n'.join(notes + outcome.errors)
            premature_finish = False
        self.status = 'incomplete'
        self.missing.append('step budget exhausted')
        return self

    async def _extract_urls(self, args):
        kind = args.get('kind') or (next(iter(self.mission.kinds)) if len(self.mission.kinds) == 1 else None)
        if kind not in KINDS:
            return 'ERROR: select a fact kind before opening sources'
        selected = list(dict.fromkeys(self.site.absolute(str(u)) for u in args.get('urls') or []))[:12]
        gate = asyncio.Semaphore(4)
        async def fetch(url):
            if not self.site.was_seen(url):
                return url, 'ERROR: URL was not observed'
            key = (kind, url, getattr(self.site, 'session_generation', 0))
            if key in self.source_cache:
                return url, self.source_cache[key]
            async with gate:
                return url, await self.site.read_url(url)
        fetched = await asyncio.gather(*(fetch(url) for url in selected))
        items = [(url, text) for url, text in fetched if not text.startswith('ERROR')]
        orch = getattr(self.extractor, '__self__', None)
        if orch and hasattr(orch, 'extract_many'):
            summaries = await orch.extract_many(kind, items, via='page') if items else []
        else:
            summaries = await asyncio.gather(*(self.extractor(kind, text, url, via='page') for url, text in items))
        blocks = [url + ': ' + text for url, text in fetched if text.startswith('ERROR')]
        for (url, text), summary in zip(items, summaries):
            if not summary.startswith('extraction returned nothing'):
                self.source_cache[(kind, url, getattr(self.site, 'session_generation', 0))] = text
            # All offered links are returned. No hidden "offered" set suppresses
            # records that exceeded a previous prompt's character limit.
            links = _links([(url, text)])
            blocks.append(url + ': ' + summary + ('\nSOURCE LINKS:\n' + '\n'.join(label + ' -> ' + link for label, link in links) if links else ''))
        return '\n'.join(blocks)

"""Snapshot-bound decisions and exact, reversible evidence views."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

REF = re.compile(r'\[(?:f\d+)?e\d+\]')


def digest(value) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]


@dataclass
class Coverage:
    scope: str
    sources: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    complete: bool = False
    gaps: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    ordering: str = ''


@dataclass
class Observation:
    id: str
    url: str
    text: str
    regions: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tables: dict[str, list[list[str]]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    controls: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    changed: bool = True

    @classmethod
    def capture(cls, text: str, url: str, previous=None):
        snapshot = cls(digest([url, text]), url, text)
        snapshot.changed = previous is None or snapshot.id != previous.id
        region, table = [], []
        def flush_region():
            if region:
                snapshot.regions['r' + str(len(snapshot.regions) + 1)] = '\n'.join(region)
                region.clear()
        def flush_table():
            if table:
                snapshot.tables['t' + str(len(snapshot.tables) + 1)] = list(table)
                table.clear()
        for line in text.splitlines():
            for match in REF.finditer(line):
                snapshot.controls[match[0][1:-1]] = line
            if line.startswith('| ') and line.endswith(' |'):
                # Tables with embedded separators in cells stay a model task.
                table.append([cell.strip() for cell in line[2:-2].split(' | ')])
            else:
                flush_table()
            if len('\n'.join(region)) + len(line) > 2400:
                flush_region()
            region.append(line)
        flush_table()
        flush_region()
        return snapshot

    def view(self, limit=6500):
        """Include controls and exact content regions; omitted regions stay addressable."""
        lines = [f'snapshot={self.id}; changed={self.changed}; URL={self.url}']
        table_lines = {'| ' + ' | '.join(row) + ' |' for rows in self.tables.values() for row in rows[1:]}
        lines.extend(dict.fromkeys(line for line in self.controls.values() if line not in table_lines))
        for key, rows in self.tables.items():
            for row in rows[1:4]:
                lines.append(f'{key} sample: ' + ' | '.join(row))
            for row in rows[4:]:
                # Row controls remain observable, without repeatedly copying all
                # business values. The full row remains in its evidence region.
                for cell in row:
                    if REF.search(cell):
                        lines.append(f'{key} row control: {cell}')
        lines.extend(f'table {key}: header={rows[0]!r}; rows={len(rows)-1}' for key, rows in self.tables.items())
        used = sum(len(x) for x in lines)
        for key, text in self.regions.items():
            # Interactive lines were already listed; removing duplicate copies
            # does not change identifiers, numerical punctuation or source text.
            content = '\n'.join(line for line in text.splitlines() if not REF.search(line) and line not in table_lines)
            if used + len(content) <= limit:
                lines.append(f'[{key}]\n{content}')
                used += len(content)
            else:
                lines.append(f'[{key}: {len(text)} chars omitted; read_region or extract to read completely]')
        return '\n'.join(lines)


@dataclass
class Decision:
    snapshot_id: str
    facts: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    actions: list[tuple[str, dict]] = field(default_factory=list)
    bindings: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    coverage: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    gaps: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, data, snapshot_id, allowed):
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get('snapshot_id', snapshot_id) != snapshot_id:
            raise ValueError('decision belongs to another observation')
        actions = []
        for action in (data.get('actions') or data.get('do') or [])[:8]:
            if not isinstance(action, dict):
                raise ValueError('action must be an object')
            action = dict(action)
            name = action.pop('a', action.pop('name', ''))
            if name not in allowed:
                raise ValueError('unknown action ' + str(name))
            actions.append((name, action))
        return cls(snapshot_id, data.get('facts') or [], actions, data.get('bindings') or [],
                   data.get('coverage') or [], data.get('gaps') or [])


@dataclass
class ActionResult:
    applied: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    readbacks: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    next_snapshot: str = ''


def table_data(observation: Observation, binding: dict):
    """Parse only the table and semantic fields chosen by the model."""
    rows = observation.tables.get(binding.get('table'))
    if not rows or len(rows) < 2:
        raise ValueError('selected table has no records')
    columns, headers = binding.get('columns') or {}, rows[0]
    if binding.get('headers') != headers:
        raise ValueError('table headers changed or were not verified')
    if len(headers) != len(set(headers)):
        raise ValueError('ambiguous duplicate table headers')
    if not columns or any(not isinstance(i, int) or isinstance(i, bool) or i < 0 or i >= len(headers)
                          for i in columns.values()):
        raise ValueError('invalid column mapping')
    records = []
    for i, row in enumerate(rows[1:], 1):
        if len(row) != len(headers):
            raise ValueError('irregular table must be read by the model')
        record = {key: row[index] for key, index in columns.items()}
        records.append(record)
    data = dict(binding.get('context') or {})
    data[str(binding['list_field'])] = records
    return data

import hashlib
import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

REF = re.compile(r'\[(?:f\d+)?e\d+\]')


def digest(value) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]


@dataclass
class Coverage:
    scope: str
    sources: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    complete: bool = False
    gaps: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    ordering: str = ''


@dataclass
class Observation:
    id: str
    url: str
    text: str
    regions: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tables: dict[str, list[list[str]]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    controls: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    changed: bool = True

    @classmethod
    def capture(cls, text: str, url: str, previous=None):
        snapshot = cls(digest([url, text]), url, text)
        snapshot.changed = previous is None or snapshot.id != previous.id
        region, table = [], []
        def flush_region():
            if region:
                snapshot.regions['r' + str(len(snapshot.regions) + 1)] = '\n'.join(region)
                region.clear()
        def flush_table():
            if table:
                snapshot.tables['t' + str(len(snapshot.tables) + 1)] = list(table)
                table.clear()
        for line in text.splitlines():
            for match in REF.finditer(line):
                snapshot.controls[match[0][1:-1]] = line
            if line.startswith('| ') and line.endswith(' |'):
                # Tables with embedded separators in cells stay a model task.
                table.append([cell.strip() for cell in line[2:-2].split(' | ')])
            else:
                flush_table()
            if len('\n'.join(region)) + len(line) > 2400:
                flush_region()
            region.append(line)
        flush_table()
        flush_region()
        return snapshot

    def view(self, limit=6500):
        """Include controls and exact content regions; omitted regions stay addressable."""
        lines = [f'snapshot={self.id}; changed={self.changed}; URL={self.url}']
        table_lines = {'| ' + ' | '.join(row) + ' |' for rows in self.tables.values() for row in rows[1:]}
        lines.extend(dict.fromkeys(line for line in self.controls.values() if line not in table_lines))
        for key, rows in self.tables.items():
            for row in rows[1:4]:
                lines.append(f'{key} sample: ' + ' | '.join(row))
            for row in rows[4:]:
                # Row controls remain observable, without repeatedly copying all
                # business values. The full row remains in its evidence region.
                for cell in row:
                    if REF.search(cell):
                        lines.append(f'{key} row control: {cell}')
        lines.extend(f'table {key}: header={rows[0]!r}; rows={len(rows)-1}' for key, rows in self.tables.items())
        used = sum(len(x) for x in lines)
        for key, text in self.regions.items():
            # Interactive lines were already listed; removing duplicate copies
            # does not change identifiers, numerical punctuation or source text.
            content = '\n'.join(line for line in text.splitlines() if not REF.search(line) and line not in table_lines)
            if used + len(content) <= limit:
                lines.append(f'[{key}]\n{content}')
                used += len(content)
            else:
                lines.append(f'[{key}: {len(text)} chars omitted; read_region or extract to read completely]')
        return '\n'.join(lines)


@dataclass
class Decision:
    snapshot_id: str
    facts: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    actions: list[tuple[str, dict]] = field(default_factory=list)
    bindings: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    coverage: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    gaps: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, data, snapshot_id, allowed):
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get('snapshot_id', snapshot_id) != snapshot_id:
            raise ValueError('decision belongs to another observation')
        actions = []
        for action in (data.get('actions') or data.get('do') or [])[:8]:
            if not isinstance(action, dict):
                raise ValueError('action must be an object')
            action = dict(action)
            name = action.pop('a', action.pop('name', ''))
            if name not in allowed:
                raise ValueError('unknown action ' + str(name))
            actions.append((name, action))
        return cls(snapshot_id, data.get('facts') or [], actions, data.get('bindings') or [],
                   data.get('coverage') or [], data.get('gaps') or [])

def table_data(observation: Observation, binding: dict):
    """Parse only the table and semantic fields chosen by the model."""
    rows = observation.tables.get(binding.get('table'))
    if not rows or len(rows) < 2:
        raise ValueError('selected table has no records')
    columns, headers = binding.get('columns') or {}, rows[0]
    if binding.get('headers') != headers:
        raise ValueError('table headers changed or were not verified')
    if len(headers) != len(set(headers)):
        raise ValueError('ambiguous duplicate table headers')
    if not columns or any(not isinstance(i, int) or isinstance(i, bool) or i < 0 or i >= len(headers)
                          for i in columns.values()):
        raise ValueError('invalid column mapping')
    records = []
    for i, row in enumerate(rows[1:], 1):
        if len(row) != len(headers):
            raise ValueError('irregular table must be read by the model')
        record = {key: row[index] for key, index in columns.items()}
        records.append(record)
    data = dict(binding.get('context') or {})
    data[str(binding['list_field'])] = records
    return data

def _mentions(text, reference) -> bool:
    """'Ausschreibung VG-1' mentions VG-1; 'VG-11' does not."""
    t, r = parse.clean(text).upper(), parse.clean(reference).upper()
    return bool(r) and re.search(rf"(?<![A-Z0-9]){re.escape(r)}(?![A-Z0-9])", t) is not None


def pick_tan(messages: list[dict], reference) -> tuple[dict | None, str]:
    """The newest TAN message (highest request number) for our exact tender. A message without a correlated
    tender reference does not authorize signing. Returns (message, "") or (None, "none" | "foreign")."""
    tans = [m for m in messages if (m.get("data") or {}).get("tan")]
    mine = ([m for m in tans if parse.norm_id(m.get("reference")) == parse.norm_id(reference)]
            or [m for m in tans if _mentions(m.get("reference"), reference)]
            )
    if not mine:
        return None, "foreign" if tans else "none"
    return max(mine, key=lambda m: int(re.sub(r"\D", "", str((m.get("data") or {}).get("request_number") or 0)) or 0)), ""

def pick_tan(messages: list[dict], reference) -> tuple[dict | None, str]:
    """The newest TAN message (highest request number) for our exact tender. A message without a correlated
    tender reference does not authorize signing. Returns (message, "") or (None, "none" | "foreign")."""
    tans = [m for m in messages if (m.get("data") or {}).get("tan")]
    mine = ([m for m in tans if parse.norm_id(m.get("reference")) == parse.norm_id(reference)]
            or [m for m in tans if _mentions(m.get("reference"), reference)]
            )
    if not mine:
        return None, "foreign" if tans else "none"
    return max(mine, key=lambda m: int(re.sub(r"\D", "", str((m.get("data") or {}).get("request_number") or 0)) or 0)), ""

"""Snapshot-bound decisions and exact, reversible evidence views."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

REF = re.compile(r'\[(?:f\d+)?e\d+\]')


def digest(value) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]


@dataclass
class Coverage:
    scope: str
    sources: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    complete: bool = False
    gaps: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    ordering: str = ''


@dataclass
class Observation:
    id: str
    url: str
    text: str
    regions: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tables: dict[str, list[list[str]]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    controls: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    changed: bool = True

    @classmethod
    def capture(cls, text: str, url: str, previous=None):
        snapshot = cls(digest([url, text]), url, text)
        snapshot.changed = previous is None or snapshot.id != previous.id
        region, table = [], []
        def flush_region():
            if region:
                snapshot.regions['r' + str(len(snapshot.regions) + 1)] = '\n'.join(region)
                region.clear()
        def flush_table():
            if table:
                snapshot.tables['t' + str(len(snapshot.tables) + 1)] = list(table)
                table.clear()
        for line in text.splitlines():
            for match in REF.finditer(line):
                snapshot.controls[match[0][1:-1]] = line
            if line.startswith('| ') and line.endswith(' |'):
                # Tables with embedded separators in cells stay a model task.
                table.append([cell.strip() for cell in line[2:-2].split(' | ')])
            else:
                flush_table()
            if len('\n'.join(region)) + len(line) > 2400:
                flush_region()
            region.append(line)
        flush_table()
        flush_region()
        return snapshot

    def view(self, limit=6500):
        """Include controls and exact content regions; omitted regions stay addressable."""
        lines = [f'snapshot={self.id}; changed={self.changed}; URL={self.url}']
        table_lines = {'| ' + ' | '.join(row) + ' |' for rows in self.tables.values() for row in rows[1:]}
        lines.extend(dict.fromkeys(line for line in self.controls.values() if line not in table_lines))
        for key, rows in self.tables.items():
            for row in rows[1:4]:
                lines.append(f'{key} sample: ' + ' | '.join(row))
            for row in rows[4:]:
                # Row controls remain observable, without repeatedly copying all
                # business values. The full row remains in its evidence region.
                for cell in row:
                    if REF.search(cell):
                        lines.append(f'{key} row control: {cell}')
        lines.extend(f'table {key}: header={rows[0]!r}; rows={len(rows)-1}' for key, rows in self.tables.items())
        used = sum(len(x) for x in lines)
        for key, text in self.regions.items():
            # Interactive lines were already listed; removing duplicate copies
            # does not change identifiers, numerical punctuation or source text.
            content = '\n'.join(line for line in text.splitlines() if not REF.search(line) and line not in table_lines)
            if used + len(content) <= limit:
                lines.append(f'[{key}]\n{content}')
                used += len(content)
            else:
                lines.append(f'[{key}: {len(text)} chars omitted; read_region or extract to read completely]')
        return '\n'.join(lines)

+"""Scan the complete submitted source, including comments, for scenario leaks.
+
+Known values come from the private development oracle/recon/fixtures. Public
+paths are discovered from their actual links, not assumed from library names.
+Usage: python3 dev/check_no_leaks.py [package_dir=agent]
+"""
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from html import unescape
+from html.parser import HTMLParser
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import sys
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SOURCE_SUFFIXES = {".py", ".md", ".json", ".toml", ".js", ".txt", ".yaml", ".yml",
+                   ".html", ".css", ".sh", ".ini", ".cfg"}
+EXCLUDED_DIRS = {".venv", "__pycache__", ".git", ".pytest_cache", "node_modules"}
+# Generic authentication/search/container routes carry no scenario knowledge.
+# Their object-specific descendants, and distinctive transaction paths, do.
+GENERIC_PATHS = {"/", "/login", "/logout", "/signin", "/signout", "/search",
+                 "/documents", "/messages", "/api", "/static", "/assets", "/notice", "/command"}
+IDENTIFIER = re.compile(
+    r"\b(?:VG-\d{4}-\d{4}|LH-VG-\d{4}-\d{4}|HZ-\d{4}|"
+    r"(?:VP|TZ|K|RP|PB|MET|FX|ER|GR|R)-\d{3,4}|PRD-\d{6})\b")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Hit:
+    file: Path
+    line: int
+    value: str
+    kind: str
+
+
+def normalize_source(text: str) -> str:
+    """Catch common literal escaping without evaluating executable source."""
+    def unicode_escape(match):
+        return chr(int(match.group(1) or match.group(2), 16))
+    text = re.sub(r"\\u([0-9a-fA-F]{4})|\\x([0-9a-fA-F]{2})", unicode_escape, text)
+    return unquote(unescape(text.replace(r"\/", "/")))
+
+
+def route_path(value: str) -> str | None:
+    value = unescape(value).strip()
+    if not value.startswith(("/", "http://", "https://")):
+        return None
+    path = unquote(urlsplit(value).path).rstrip("/") or "/"
+    if path in GENERIC_PATHS or path.startswith(("/assets/", "/static/")):
+        return None
+    return path
+
+
+class FixtureLinks(HTMLParser):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.paths = set()
+
+    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attributes):
+        for name, value in attributes:
+            if name in {"href", "src", "action", "data-url", "data-href"} and value:
+                path = route_path(value)
+                if path:
+                    self.paths.add(path)
+            elif name == "srcdoc" and value:
+                nested = FixtureLinks()
+                nested.feed(unescape(value))
+                self.paths.update(nested.paths)
+
+
+def public_paths(root: Path = ROOT) -> set[str]:
+    paths = set()
+    for fixture in sorted((root / "dev/fixtures").glob("public-*/*.html")):
+        parser = FixtureLinks()
+        parser.feed(fixture.read_text(errors="ignore"))
+        paths.update(parser.paths)
+    recon = root / "docs/03-site-recon.md"
+    if recon.exists():
+        # Code spans preserve slash paths from recon prose. Avoid interpreting
+        # arbitrary filenames or division expressions as website navigation.
+        for code in re.findall(r"`([^`\n]+)`", recon.read_text()):
+            for candidate in re.findall(r"(?<![\w/])/(?:[\w.-]+/?)+(?:\?[^\s`<>]*)?", code):
+                path = route_path(candidate)
+                if path and "<" not in path and path != "/path":
+                    paths.add(path)
+    return paths
+
+
+def public_values(root: Path = ROOT) -> set[str]:
+    oracle = json.loads((root / "dev/oracle/public-1.json").read_text())
+    values = {oracle["tender_reference"]}
+    for position in oracle["positions"]:
+        values.add(position["material_number"])
+        for key in ("unit_price", "base_unit_price", "total_net"):
+            if key in position:
+                values.add(f"{position[key]:.2f}")
+    values.add(f"{oracle['total_net']:.2f}")
+    sources = [root / "docs/03-site-recon.md", root / "dev/oracle/compute_public1.py"]
+    sources.extend((root / "dev/fixtures").glob("public-*/*.html"))
+    for source in sources:
+        if source.exists():
+            values.update(IDENTIFIER.findall(normalize_source(source.read_text(errors="ignore"))))
+    values.update({"238,098", "2.743,58", "30,851", "13.25", "517.25", "1.0873", "64431", "PRD-635338",
+                   "u_9c3cb06a5d21b197", "kyora.run", "Linden Hydraulik", "DE811234567", "Buchenstadt", "linden-hydraulik"})
+    return values
+
+
+def scan_package(package: Path, *, values: set[str], paths: set[str]) -> list[Hit]:
+    hits = []
+    patterns = [(value, "value", re.compile(r"(?<![\d])" + re.escape(value) + r"(?![\d])")
+                 if re.fullmatch(r"[\d.,]+", value) else re.compile(re.escape(value))) for value in sorted(values)]
+    patterns.extend((path, "pathname", re.compile(r"(?<![\w/])" + re.escape(path) + r"(?=$|[/?#\s'\"`<>\]\)};:,])"))
+                    for path in sorted(paths))
+    for source in sorted(package.rglob("*")):
+        relative = source.relative_to(package)
+        if any(part in EXCLUDED_DIRS for part in relative.parts) or not source.is_file():
+            continue
+        if source.suffix not in SOURCE_SUFFIXES or source.name == "uv.lock":
+            continue
+        text = normalize_source(source.read_text(errors="ignore"))
+        for value, kind, pattern in patterns:
+            match = pattern.search(text)
+            if match:
+                hits.append(Hit(source, text.count("\n", 0, match.start()) + 1, value, kind))
+    return hits
+
+
+def main(argv=None) -> int:
+    args = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
+    package = Path(args[0]).resolve() if args else ROOT / "agent"
+    if not package.is_dir():
+        print(f"error: package directory does not exist: {package}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    values, paths = public_values(), public_paths()
+    hits = scan_package(package, values=values, paths=paths)
+    if hits:
+        print("LEAKS FOUND (public-scenario values or distinctive paths in the package):")
+        for hit in hits:
+            print(f"{hit.file.relative_to(package)}:{hit.line}: {hit.kind}: {hit.value}")
+        return 1
+    print(f"ok: no public-scenario values or distinctive paths in {package}/ ({len(values)} values, {len(paths)} paths)")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch"));

"""Structured JSON logging with run-local secret redaction."""
import json
import time

_T0 = time.monotonic()
_SECRETS = set()
_PRIVATE_KEYS = {'password', 'api_key', 'token', 'tan', 'authorization', 'eval_token'}


def register_secret(value):
    if value is not None and str(value):
        _SECRETS.add(str(value))


def elapsed() -> float:
    return time.monotonic() - _T0


def _clean(value, key=''):
    if key.lower() in _PRIVATE_KEYS and value is not None:
        return '[redacted]'
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): _clean(v, str(k)) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
        return [_clean(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str):
        for secret in _SECRETS:
            if len(secret) >= 4:
                value = value.replace(secret, '[redacted]')
            elif value == secret:
                value = '[redacted]'
        return value
    return value


def log(event: str, **fields) -> None:
    line = {'t': round(elapsed(), 2), 'event': event, **_clean(fields)}
    print(json.dumps(line, ensure_ascii=False, default=str), flush=True)

    spans = [event for event in events if event.get("event") == "profile_span"]

def analyze(paths: list[Path], *, seconds: float | None = None, cost: str | None = None,
            leader_cost: str = "0.02583", leader_seconds: str = "38.259") -> dict:
    captures = [read_capture(path) for path in paths]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline span/token analysis. Accept JSONL logs or Atira MCP captures.

Usage: python3 dev/profile_ledger.py LOG... --seconds 80 --cost 0.02
Never invent usage for cancelled requests or add cached tokens to input twice.
"""
import argparse
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re


def read_capture(path: Path) -> tuple[list[dict], str]:
    text = path.read_text()
    try:
        data = json.loads(text)
    except ValueError:
        data = None
    if isinstance(data, dict) and isinstance(data.get("content"), list):
        text = "\n".join(block.get("text", "") for block in data["content"]
                         if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "text")
    elif isinstance(data, dict) and "event" in data:
        return [data], text
    events = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        payload = line.partition("stdout: ")[2] if "stdout: " in line else line
        try:
            item = json.loads(payload)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if isinstance(item, dict) and "event" in item:
            events.append(item)
    return events, text


def union_seconds(intervals: list[tuple[float, float]]) -> float:
    total, end = 0.0, float("-inf")
    for start, stop in sorted(intervals):
        if stop <= start:
            continue
        total += max(0, stop - max(end, start))
        end = max(end, stop)
    return round(total, 6)


def gaps(intervals: list[tuple[float, float]], stop: float) -> list[list[float]]:
    """Observed gaps in this instrumentation, not proof that the process was idle."""
    result, cursor = [], 0.0
    for start, end in sorted(intervals):
        if start > cursor:
            result.append([round(cursor, 6), round(min(start, stop), 6)])
        cursor = max(cursor, end)
    if stop > cursor:
        result.append([round(cursor, 6), round(stop, 6)])
    return sorted((gap for gap in result if gap[1] > gap[0]),
                  key=lambda gap: gap[1] - gap[0], reverse=True)


def token_ledger(events: list[dict]) -> dict:
    usages = [event for event in events if event.get("event") == "profile_usage"]
    explicit = bool(usages)
    if not explicit:
        usages = [{"input_tokens": event["tokens"][0], "output_tokens": event["tokens"][1],
                   "cached_tokens": event["tokens"][2], "known": event["tokens"][0] is not None,
                   "reasoning_in_output": True, "reasoning_tokens": 0}
                  for event in events if event.get("event") == "llm"
                  and isinstance(event.get("tokens"), list) and len(event["tokens"]) == 3]
    totals = Counter()
    seen = {}
    for usage in usages:
        attempt = usage.get("attempt_id")
        if attempt is not None and attempt in seen:
            if seen[attempt] != usage:
                raise ValueError(f"conflicting metering for attempt {attempt}")
            continue
        if attempt is not None:
            seen[attempt] = usage
        totals["attempts"] += 1
        if not usage.get("known", False):
            totals["unknown_usage_attempts"] += 1
            continue
        incoming, outgoing = usage.get("input_tokens"), usage.get("output_tokens")
        cached, reasoning = usage.get("cached_tokens"), usage.get("reasoning_tokens", 0)
        if incoming is None or outgoing is None:
            raise ValueError("known usage lacks token counts")
        if min(incoming, outgoing, reasoning) < 0 or (cached is not None and not 0 <= cached <= incoming):
            raise ValueError("invalid token counts")
        totals["input_tokens"] += incoming
        totals["output_tokens"] += outgoing
        totals["cached_tokens"] += cached or 0
        totals["reasoning_tokens"] += reasoning
        separately_metered = reasoning if not usage.get("reasoning_in_output", True) else 0
        total = incoming + outgoing + separately_metered
        totals["total_tokens"] += total
        if usage.get("speculative"):
            totals["speculative_tokens"] += total
    fields = ("attempts", "unknown_usage_attempts", "input_tokens", "output_tokens",
              "cached_tokens", "reasoning_tokens", "speculative_tokens", "total_tokens")
    return {**{field: totals[field] for field in fields},
            "coverage": "all instrumented attempts" if explicit else "legacy successful winners only",
            "complete": explicit and totals["unknown_usage_attempts"] == 0}


def span_ledger(events: list[dict], wall_seconds: float | None = None) -> dict:
    spans = [event for event in events if event.get("event") == "profile_span"]
    groups, intervals = defaultdict(list), []
    for event in spans:
        start, seconds = float(event["start"]), float(event["seconds"])
        if start < 0 or seconds < 0:
            raise ValueError("invalid span timing")
        interval = (start, start + seconds)
        intervals.append(interval)
        groups[event.get("category") or event["name"]].append(interval)
    stop = wall_seconds if wall_seconds is not None else max((end for _, end in intervals), default=0)
    category = {name: {"count": len(values),
                       "summed_seconds": round(sum(end - start for start, end in values), 6),
                       "union_seconds": union_seconds(values)} for name, values in sorted(groups.items())}
    slow = sorted(spans, key=lambda event: event["seconds"], reverse=True)[:20]
    return {"spans": len(spans), "wall_seconds": stop, "categories": category,
            "uninstrumented_gaps": gaps(intervals, stop),
            "slowest_spans": [{key: event.get(key) for key in
                               ("id", "parent", "name", "agent", "category", "start", "seconds", "status")}
                              for event in slow],
            "note": "Summed times overlap. Union times are occupied wall time; gaps are not proof of idle time."}


def platform_snapshots(texts: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    snapshots = []
    pattern = re.compile(r"LLM: ([\d,]+) calls, \$([\d.]+), ([\d,]+) in / ([\d,]+) out tokens")
    for text in texts:
        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
            calls, cost, incoming, outgoing = match.groups()
            cache = re.search(r"in \(([\d,]+) cached\)", text)
            snapshot = {"calls": int(calls.replace(",", "")), "cost_usd": cost,
                        "input_tokens": int(incoming.replace(",", "")),
                        "output_tokens": int(outgoing.replace(",", ""))}
            snapshot["total_tokens"] = snapshot["input_tokens"] + snapshot["output_tokens"]
            snapshot["cached_tokens"] = int(cache[1].replace(",", "")) if cache else None
            snapshot["running_snapshot"] = "Status running" in text
            snapshots.append(snapshot)
    return snapshots


def analyze(paths: list[Path], *, seconds: float | None = None, cost: str | None = None,
            leader_cost: str = "0.02583", leader_seconds: str = "38.259") -> dict:
    captures = [read_capture(path) for path in paths]
    events = [event for captured, _ in captures for event in captured]
    ledger = token_ledger(events)
    snapshots = platform_snapshots([text for _, text in captures])
    lower_bound = max([ledger["total_tokens"]] + [snapshot["total_tokens"] for snapshot in snapshots])
    report = {"tokens": ledger, "platform_snapshots": snapshots,
              "observed_token_lower_bound": lower_bound,
              "within_200k": False if lower_bound > 200_000 else (True if ledger["complete"] else None),
              "timing": span_ledger(events, seconds),
              "actions": dict(Counter(event.get("tool", "unknown") for event in events
                                      if event.get("event") == "action")),
              "budget_note": "Use final platform totals for acceptance; cached input is included once. "
                             "Cancelled/unmetered requests and incomplete captures prevent a passing claim."}
    if seconds is not None and cost is not None:
        product = Decimal(cost) * Decimal(str(seconds))
        leader = Decimal(leader_cost) * Decimal(leader_seconds)
        report["comparison"] = {"cost_usd": cost, "seconds": seconds, "cost_times_seconds": str(product),
                                "leader_product": str(leader), "relative_product": str(product / leader),
                                "under_90_seconds": seconds < 90,
                                "cost_needed_at_90_seconds": str(leader / Decimal(90))}
    return report


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("captures", nargs="+", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=float)
    parser.add_argument("--cost")
    parser.add_argument("--leader-cost", default="0.02583")
    parser.add_argument("--leader-seconds", default="38.259")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(analyze(args.captures, seconds=args.seconds, cost=args.cost,
                             leader_cost=args.leader_cost, leader_seconds=args.leader_seconds), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"""Profiling stays causal, counts all metered work, and excludes source values."""
import asyncio
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from rfq import profile

_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "profile_ledger", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "dev" / "profile_ledger.py")
ledger = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(ledger)


@pytest.fixture
def events(monkeypatch):
    captured = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "ENABLED", True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "log", lambda event, **fields: captured.append({"event": event, **fields}))
    return captured


def test_parallel_nested_spans_keep_task_parents_and_cancellation(events):
    async def scenario():
        async def worker():
            async with profile.span("decision", category="decision") as decision:
                async with profile.span("request", category="model") as request:
                    await asyncio.sleep(0)
                assert request.parent == decision.id
        with profile.span("run") as run:
            await asyncio.gather(worker(), worker())
            task = asyncio.create_task(cancelled())
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
            task.cancel()
            with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task
        assert all(event["parent"] == run.id for event in events if event["name"] == "decision")

    async def cancelled():
        async with profile.span("cancelled_request"):
            await asyncio.Event().wait()

    asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert next(event for event in events if event["name"] == "cancelled_request")["status"] == "cancelled"
    assert profile._parent.get() is None
    assert all(event["seconds"] >= 0 for event in events)


def test_disabled_spans_do_not_read_clocks_or_emit(monkeypatch, events):
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "ENABLED", False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile.time, "monotonic_ns", lambda: pytest.fail("disabled profiler read the clock"))
    with profile.span("disabled"):
        pass
    assert events == []


def test_metadata_rejects_source_values_and_prompt_counts_do_not_copy(events):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        profile.span("form", secret="hidden")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        profile.span("form", rows="hidden")
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "synthetic"},
                                               {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "hidden"}}]}]
    assert profile.prompt_metrics(messages) == {"characters": 9, "images": 1}
    assert events == []


def test_metering_counts_cached_input_once_and_speculative_work(events):
    profile.model_usage(attempt_id=10, model="synthetic", input_tokens=1000, output_tokens=20,
                        cached_tokens=800, reasoning_tokens=5)
    profile.model_usage(attempt_id=11, model="synthetic", input_tokens=500, output_tokens=10,
                        cached_tokens=400, reasoning_tokens=7, reasoning_in_output=False, speculative=True)
    profile.model_usage(attempt_id=12, model="synthetic", known=False, speculative=True)
    result = ledger.token_ledger(events + [events[0]])
    assert result["attempts"] == 3
    assert result["total_tokens"] == 1537
    assert result["cached_tokens"] == 1200
    assert result["speculative_tokens"] == 517
    assert result["unknown_usage_attempts"] == 1 and not result["complete"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        profile.model_usage(attempt_id=13, model="synthetic", input_tokens=3, output_tokens=1, cached_tokens=4)


def test_overlapping_spans_are_not_summed_as_wall_time():
    events = [dict(event="profile_span", id=1, name="request", category="model", start=2, seconds=5),
              dict(event="profile_span", id=2, name="request", category="model", start=4, seconds=7)]
    result = ledger.span_ledger(events, wall_seconds=15)
    assert result["categories"]["model"] == {"count": 2, "summed_seconds": 12, "union_seconds": 9}
    assert result["uninstrumented_gaps"] == [[11, 15], [0, 2]]


def test_incomplete_platform_capture_cannot_pass_budget(tmp_path):
    capture = tmp_path / "capture.json"
    capture.write_text('{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Status running\\n'
                       'LLM: 10 calls, $0.01, 90,000 in / 10,000 out tokens\\n'
                       'model: 90,000 in (80,000 cached) / 10,000 out"}]}')
    result = ledger.analyze([capture])
    assert result["observed_token_lower_bound"] == 100_000
    assert result["within_200k"] is None
    assert result["platform_snapshots"][0]["cached_tokens"] == 80_000

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline span/token analysis. Accept JSONL logs or Atira MCP captures.

Usage: python3 dev/profile_ledger.py LOG... --seconds 80 --cost 0.02
Never invent usage for cancelled requests or add cached tokens to input twice.
"""
import argparse
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re


def read_capture(path: Path) -> tuple[list[dict], str]:
    text = path.read_text()
    try:
        data = json.loads(text)
    except ValueError:
        data = None
    if isinstance(data, dict) and isinstance(data.get("content"), list):
        text = "\n".join(block.get("text", "") for block in data["content"]
                         if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "text")
    elif isinstance(data, dict) and "event" in data:
        return [data], text
    events = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        payload = line.partition("stdout: ")[2] if "stdout: " in line else line
        try:
            item = json.loads(payload)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if isinstance(item, dict) and "event" in item:
            events.append(item)
    return events, text


def union_seconds(intervals: list[tuple[float, float]]) -> float:
    total, end = 0.0, float("-inf")
    for start, stop in sorted(intervals):
        if stop <= start:
            continue
        total += max(0, stop - max(end, start))
        end = max(end, stop)
    return round(total, 6)


def gaps(intervals: list[tuple[float, float]], stop: float) -> list[list[float]]:
    """Observed gaps in this instrumentation, not proof that the process was idle."""
    result, cursor = [], 0.0
    for start, end in sorted(intervals):
        if start > cursor:
            result.append([round(cursor, 6), round(min(start, stop), 6)])
        cursor = max(cursor, end)
    if stop > cursor:
        result.append([round(cursor, 6), round(stop, 6)])
    return sorted((gap for gap in result if gap[1] > gap[0]),
                  key=lambda gap: gap[1] - gap[0], reverse=True)


def token_ledger(events: list[dict]) -> dict:
    usages = [event for event in events if event.get("event") == "profile_usage"]
    explicit = bool(usages)
    if not explicit:
        usages = [{"input_tokens": event["tokens"][0], "output_tokens": event["tokens"][1],
                   "cached_tokens": event["tokens"][2], "known": event["tokens"][0] is not None,
                   "reasoning_in_output": True, "reasoning_tokens": 0}
                  for event in events if event.get("event") == "llm"
                  and isinstance(event.get("tokens"), list) and len(event["tokens"]) == 3]
    totals = Counter()
    seen = {}
    for usage in usages:
        attempt = usage.get("attempt_id")
        if attempt is not None and attempt in seen:
            if seen[attempt] != usage:
                raise ValueError(f"conflicting metering for attempt {attempt}")
            continue
        if attempt is not None:
            seen[attempt] = usage
        totals["attempts"] += 1
        if not usage.get("known", False):
            totals["unknown_usage_attempts"] += 1
            continue
        incoming, outgoing = usage.get("input_tokens"), usage.get("output_tokens")
        cached, reasoning = usage.get("cached_tokens"), usage.get("reasoning_tokens", 0)
        if incoming is None or outgoing is None:
            raise ValueError("known usage lacks token counts")
        if min(incoming, outgoing, reasoning) < 0 or (cached is not None and not 0 <= cached <= incoming):
            raise ValueError("invalid token counts")
        totals["input_tokens"] += incoming
        totals["output_tokens"] += outgoing
        totals["cached_tokens"] += cached or 0
        totals["reasoning_tokens"] += reasoning
        separately_metered = reasoning if not usage.get("reasoning_in_output", True) else 0
        total = incoming + outgoing + separately_metered
        totals["total_tokens"] += total
        if usage.get("speculative"):
            totals["speculative_tokens"] += total
    fields = ("attempts", "unknown_usage_attempts", "input_tokens", "output_tokens",
              "cached_tokens", "reasoning_tokens", "speculative_tokens", "total_tokens")
    return {**{field: totals[field] for field in fields},
            "coverage": "all instrumented attempts" if explicit else "legacy successful winners only",
            "complete": explicit and totals["unknown_usage_attempts"] == 0}


def span_ledger(events: list[dict], wall_seconds: float | None = None) -> dict:
    spans = [event for event in events if event.get("event") == "profile_span"]
    groups, intervals = defaultdict(list), []
    for event in spans:
        start, seconds = float(event["start"]), float(event["seconds"])
        if start < 0 or seconds < 0:
            raise ValueError("invalid span timing")
        interval = (start, start + seconds)
        intervals.append(interval)
        groups[event.get("category") or event["name"]].append(interval)
    stop = wall_seconds if wall_seconds is not None else max((end for _, end in intervals), default=0)
    category = {name: {"count": len(values),
                       "summed_seconds": round(sum(end - start for start, end in values), 6),
                       "union_seconds": union_seconds(values)} for name, values in sorted(groups.items())}
    slow = sorted(spans, key=lambda event: event["seconds"], reverse=True)[:20]
    return {"spans": len(spans), "wall_seconds": stop, "categories": category,
            "uninstrumented_gaps": gaps(intervals, stop),
            "slowest_spans": [{key: event.get(key) for key in
                               ("id", "parent", "name", "agent", "category", "start", "seconds", "status")}
                              for event in slow],
            "note": "Summed times overlap. Union times are occupied wall time; gaps are not proof of idle time."}


def platform_snapshots(texts: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    snapshots = []
    pattern = re.compile(r"LLM: ([\d,]+) calls, \$([\d.]+), ([\d,]+) in / ([\d,]+) out tokens")
    for text in texts:
        for match in pattern.finditer(text):
            calls, cost, incoming, outgoing = match.groups()
            cache = re.search(r"in \(([\d,]+) cached\)", text)
            snapshot = {"calls": int(calls.replace(",", "")), "cost_usd": cost,
                        "input_tokens": int(incoming.replace(",", "")),
                        "output_tokens": int(outgoing.replace(",", ""))}
            snapshot["total_tokens"] = snapshot["input_tokens"] + snapshot["output_tokens"]
            snapshot["cached_tokens"] = int(cache[1].replace(",", "")) if cache else None
            snapshot["running_snapshot"] = "Status running" in text
            snapshots.append(snapshot)
    return snapshots


def analyze(paths: list[Path], *, seconds: float | None = None, cost: str | None = None,
            leader_cost: str = "0.02583", leader_seconds: str = "38.259") -> dict:
    captures = [read_capture(path) for path in paths]
    events = [event for captured, _ in captures for event in captured]
    ledger = token_ledger(events)
    snapshots = platform_snapshots([text for _, text in captures])
    lower_bound = max([ledger["total_tokens"]] + [snapshot["total_tokens"] for snapshot in snapshots])
    report = {"tokens": ledger, "platform_snapshots": snapshots,
              "observed_token_lower_bound": lower_bound,
              "within_200k": False if lower_bound > 200_000 else (True if ledger["complete"] else None),
              "timing": span_ledger(events, seconds),
              "actions": dict(Counter(event.get("tool", "unknown") for event in events
                                      if event.get("event") == "action")),
              "budget_note": "Use final platform totals for acceptance; cached input is included once. "
                             "Cancelled/unmetered requests and incomplete captures prevent a passing claim."}
    if seconds is not None and cost is not None:
        product = Decimal(cost) * Decimal(str(seconds))
        leader = Decimal(leader_cost) * Decimal(leader_seconds)
        report["comparison"] = {"cost_usd": cost, "seconds": seconds, "cost_times_seconds": str(product),
                                "leader_product": str(leader), "relative_product": str(product / leader),
                                "under_90_seconds": seconds < 90,
                                "cost_needed_at_90_seconds": str(leader / Decimal(90))}
    return report


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("captures", nargs="+", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=float)
    parser.add_argument("--cost")
    parser.add_argument("--leader-cost", default="0.02583")
    parser.add_argument("--leader-seconds", default="38.259")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(analyze(args.captures, seconds=args.seconds, cost=args.cost,
                             leader_cost=args.leader_cost, leader_seconds=args.leader_seconds), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"""Profiling stays causal, counts all metered work, and excludes source values."""
import asyncio
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from rfq import profile

_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "profile_ledger", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "dev" / "profile_ledger.py")
ledger = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(ledger)


@pytest.fixture
def events(monkeypatch):
    captured = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "ENABLED", True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "log", lambda event, **fields: captured.append({"event": event, **fields}))
    return captured


def test_parallel_nested_spans_keep_task_parents_and_cancellation(events):
    async def scenario():
        async def worker():
            async with profile.span("decision", category="decision") as decision:
                async with profile.span("request", category="model") as request:
                    await asyncio.sleep(0)
                assert request.parent == decision.id
        with profile.span("run") as run:
            await asyncio.gather(worker(), worker())
            task = asyncio.create_task(cancelled())
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
            task.cancel()
            with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task
        assert all(event["parent"] == run.id for event in events if event["name"] == "decision")

    async def cancelled():
        async with profile.span("cancelled_request"):
            await asyncio.Event().wait()

    asyncio.run(scenario())
    assert next(event for event in events if event["name"] == "cancelled_request")["status"] == "cancelled"
    assert profile._parent.get() is None
    assert all(event["seconds"] >= 0 for event in events)


def test_disabled_spans_do_not_read_clocks_or_emit(monkeypatch, events):
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile, "ENABLED", False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(profile.time, "monotonic_ns", lambda: pytest.fail("disabled profiler read the clock"))
    with profile.span("disabled"):
        pass
    assert events == []


def test_metadata_rejects_source_values_and_prompt_counts_do_not_copy(events):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        profile.span("form", secret="hidden")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        profile.span("form", rows="hidden")
    messages = [{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "synthetic"},
                                               {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "hidden"}}]}]
    assert profile.prompt_metrics(messages) == {"characters": 9, "images": 1}
    assert events == []


def test_metering_counts_cached_input_once_and_speculative_work(events):
    profile.model_usage(attempt_id=10, model="synthetic", input_tokens=1000, output_tokens=20,
                        cached_tokens=800, reasoning_tokens=5)
    profile.model_usage(attempt_id=11, model="synthetic", input_tokens=500, output_tokens=10,
                        cached_tokens=400, reasoning_tokens=7, reasoning_in_output=False, speculative=True)
    profile.model_usage(attempt_id=12, model="synthetic", known=False, speculative=True)
    result = ledger.token_ledger(events + [events[0]])
    assert result["attempts"] == 3
    assert result["total_tokens"] == 1537
    assert result["cached_tokens"] == 1200
    assert result["speculative_tokens"] == 517
    assert result["unknown_usage_attempts"] == 1 and not result["complete"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        profile.model_usage(attempt_id=13, model="synthetic", input_tokens=3, output_tokens=1, cached_tokens=4)


def test_overlapping_spans_are_not_summed_as_wall_time():
    events = [dict(event="profile_span", id=1, name="request", category="model", start=2, seconds=5),
              dict(event="profile_span", id=2, name="request", category="model", start=4, seconds=7)]
    result = ledger.span_ledger(events, wall_seconds=15)
    assert result["categories"]["model"] == {"count": 2, "summed_seconds": 12, "union_seconds": 9}
    assert result["uninstrumented_gaps"] == [[11, 15], [0, 2]]


def test_incomplete_platform_capture_cannot_pass_budget(tmp_path):
    capture = tmp_path / "capture.json"
    capture.write_text('{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Status running\\n'
                       'LLM: 10 calls, $0.01, 90,000 in / 10,000 out tokens\\n'
                       'model: 90,000 in (80,000 cached) / 10,000 out"}]}')
    result = ledger.analyze([capture])
    assert result["observed_token_lower_bound"] == 100_000
    assert result["within_200k"] is None
    assert result["platform_snapshots"][0]["cached_tokens"] == 80_000

+total_input = input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens

+total_tokens = usage.prompt_tokens + usage.completion_tokens
